abstract.summaryZh: 摘要 遊戲化經常被用來透過無形的獎勵來激發學習者的參與度，例如虛擬點數和虛擬徽章，而不是物質商品或利益。 結果為計劃在他們的遊戲化課程中使用有形獎勵的教師提供了實際意義。 本文補充說，本研究進行了一項隨機對照實驗，以比較可贖回的有形獎勵和無形獎勵對學生內在動機、行為參與、認知參與和學習表現的影響。 從業者還應該設定一個具體且適度具有挑戰性的救贖目標。
abstract.faithfulZh: 遊戲化經常被用來透過無形的獎勵（例如虛擬積分和虛擬徽章）來刺激學習者的參與，而不是物質商品或利益。 然而，並非所有學習者都重視這種無形的獎勵。 有些人表達了他們希望用無用的資源或利益贖回無形獎勵的願望。 儘管有形獎勵長期以來一直被認為是商業忠誠度計劃中的關鍵遊戲化機制，但很少有研究明確探討其在遊戲化教育的背景下的有效性。 為了解決這一差距，本研究使用隨機對照試驗方法來檢查透過無形獎勵贖回的有形獎勵對學生內在動機、行為和認知參與以及在完全線上的遊戲化翻轉課堂學習表現的影響的影響。 每個學生被隨機分配到有形獎勵組（例如 = 28）或無形獎勵組（CG = 29）。 EG 中的學生在期末考試中的內在動機、行為參與、認知參與和學習表現方面的表現明顯優於 CG 中的學生。 結果為計劃在他們的遊戲化課程中使用有形獎勵的教師提供了實際意義。 從業者注意到關於這個主題的已知內容 完全線上學習通常會因缺乏學生參與而受到影響。 遊戲化通常用於透過無形獎勵（例如，虛擬積分和徽章）來刺激學習者的參與，這些獎勵（例如，虛擬積分和徽章）不包含遊戲化系統之外的任何功利性好處。 並非所有學習者都重視無形獎勵——相反，他們希望將無形徽章或積分轉化為更實用的好處/資源。 本文補充說，本研究進行了一項隨機對照實驗，以比較可贖回的有形獎勵和無形獎勵對學生內在動機、行為參與、認知參與和學習表現的影響。 有形獎勵組在各個方面的表現都明顯優於無形獎勵組。 對使用有形獎勵進行練習的影響比在遊戲化學習中僅使用無形獎勵要好。 從業者應該將有形的獎勵與績效標準聯絡起來。 從業者還應該設定一個具體且適度具有挑戰性的救贖目標。

links.evidenceQuote: The experiment was conducted in two yogism classes of 100 min per week. The experimental procedure is shown in Fig. 6. During weeks 1–8, the teacher introduced the teaching content, test items, and evaluation criteria, and assigned students to their groups for the class activities. The course content began with warm-up and protective exercises to teach students how to perform movements safely, followed by the instruction of a set of essential yogism movements. In the 9th week, a pretest of yogism movement performance was conducted.

links.evidenceQuote: The teaching intervention was conducted during weeks 10 to 14, with each week focusing on an advanced yogism movement. By the end of the 5 weeks, students would learn a set of advanced yogism movements. In the learning process, the teacher first introduced, explained, and demonstrated the movements, followed by student practice. Both groups of students employed the AI movement assessment and feedback system for learning. They worked in small groups, took photos of their movements, and uploaded them to the system. The AI system would then evaluate the accuracy of the movements and provide corresponding feedback and scores, offering students a basis for learning and improvement (see Fig. 7). What differentiated the two groups was that the experimental group used the approach integrated with gamification mechanisms. After uploading their movements, students in the experimental group could view their rankings relative to the entire class and earn rewards (e.g., badges and titles) and achievements. Additionally, students could view their group rankings, which fostered competition and engagement through gamification. In contrast, the control group only received feedback on their performance from the AI system without any game elements. A posttest of yogism movement skills performance was administered in the 15th week.

paper-04.title: Enhancing engagement and collaborative creativity in health promotion education through co-creative game-based learning
paper-04.sourceFileName: 4. Enhancing engagement and collaborative creativity in health promotion education through co-creative game-based learning.pdf

segments.sourceText: ABSTRACT This study examines the impact of a co-creative game-based learning (GBL) intervention on student engagement and collaborative creativity in a Taiwanese undergraduate health promotion course. Responding to pedagogical reforms emphasising practice-oriented competencies, the course embedded a participatory task in which students collaboratively designed educational board games targeting elementary school audiences. Quantitative outcomes included learning engagement and collaborative creativity, measured through validated scales, alongside qualitative student reflections. The results exhibited significant improvements in both engagement and collaborative creativity, with the greatest gains observed among students with lower academic standing and motivation. Qualitative data highlighted students’ enhanced capacity to translate abstract theory into accessible content, increased teamwork skills, and heightened professional identity awareness. The study contributes empirical evidence to the emerging field of participatory GBL, highlighting its effectiveness in promoting engagement, creativity, and equitable learning opportunities within competencybased health promotion education.

translation.faithfulZh: 本研究探討共創式遊戲式學習（GBL）介入對臺灣大學健康促進課程中學生投入與協作創造力的影響。為回應強調實務導向能力的教學改革，課程安排一項參與式任務，讓學生共同設計以國小學童為對象的教育桌上遊戲。量化結果包含使用經驗證量表測得的學習投入與協作創造力，並搭配學生的質性反思。結果顯示，學生的學習投入與協作創造力皆顯著提升，其中學業表現與動機較低的學生進步最大。質性資料指出，學生將抽象理論轉化為易懂內容的能力、團隊合作技能，以及對專業身分的覺察均有所提升。本研究為正在發展中的參與式 GBL 領域提供實證，顯示此方法能在能力導向的健康促進教育中促進投入、創造力與更公平的學習機會。

segments.sourceText: In response to these needs, educators have sought innovative pedagogical models that integrate creativity and collaboration. Design-based learning (DBL) and co-creative GBL are promising approaches that position learners as active creators rather than passive players (Romero et al., 2019; Zaw Oo et al., 2024). Engaging students as game designers encourages them to analyse, reorganise, and apply theoretical concepts in meaningful contexts, thereby strengthening reflective thinking, facilitating the transfer of theory-topractice, and fostering collaborative creativity (Casey & Hastie, 2011; Palmquist et al., 2024). This participatory approach aligns with health promotion principles, which emphasise empowerment, collaboration, and active engagement (Glăveanu & Beghetto, 2021; Thornhill-Miller et al., 2023), providing a relevant framework for preparing future public health professionals.

segments.sourceText: Studies illustrate that GBL enhances learners’ motivation, engagement, and performance across disciplines (Jones et al., 2022; Zhang & Yu, 2022). This process fosters ownership and agency. Additionally, it supports students with lower achievement or confidence, offering them opportunities to demonstrate understanding through meaningful creation.

translation.plainZh: 基於遊戲的學習 (GBL) 和遊戲設計透過將遊戲原理和機制整合到結構化學習環境中來支援參與、動機和成就，從而建立了有效的教學方法。

segments.sourceText: GBL has been increasingly recognised as an effective pedagogical approach that integrates game principles and mechanics into structured learning environments to support engagement, motivation, and achievement (Pan et al., 2021; Sailer & Homner, 2020). Unlike gamification, which merely includes external rewards, GBL situates learning within the game itself, using play or design as a medium for knowledge construction and reflection.

translation.faithfulZh: GBL 越來越被認為是一種有效的教學方法，將遊戲原理和機制整合到結構化學習環境中，以支援參與、動機和成就（Pan et al.，2021；Sailer & Homner，2020）。 與僅包含外部獎勵的遊戲化不同，GBL 將學習置於遊戲本身中，使用遊戲或設計作為知識構建和反思的媒介。
translation.plainZh: GBL 被認為是一種有效的教學法，因為它透過滿足學習者對自主、能力和相關性的需求來增強內在動力，透過有意義的目標和互動體驗來促進參與。

segments.sourceText: The effectiveness of GBL can be theoretically explained by self-determination theory (Ryan & Deci, 2000) and flow theory (Csikszentmihalyi, 1990), as it enhances intrinsic motivation by satisfying learners’ needs for autonomy, competence, and relatedness through meaningful goals, feedback, and interactive experiences. These mechanisms explain why GBL sustains learners’ attention and supports deeper engagement in the learning process (Lüking et al., 2023).

translation.faithfulZh: GBL 的有效性可以透過自決理論 (Ryan & Deci, 2000) 和流動理論 (Csikszentmihalyi, 1990) 來解釋，因為它透過滿足學習者的需求來增強內在動機 透過有意義的目標、回饋和互動體驗的自主、能力和相關性。 這些機制解釋了為什麼 GBL 可以維持學習者的注意力並支援更深入地參與學習過程（Lüking 等，2023）。
translation.plainZh: 研究表明，GBL 透過促進跨學科的解決問題和適應性思維，提高了動力、享受和知識的保留。
translation.generatedBy: Chrome on-device AI via Codex batch pipeline

segments.sourceText: Empirical research across computer science, engineering, music, language learning, and health-related disciplines (Alhammad & Moreno, 2018; Lee et al., 2023; van Gaalen et al., 2021; Van Roy & Zaman, 2018) demonstrates that well-designed GBL enhances motivation, enjoyment, and knowledge retention while fostering problem-solving and adaptive thinking.

translation.plainZh: 學生對遊戲設計的參與透過需要對內容的分析、組織和創造性應用來增強學習，最終促進更深入的理解和理論到實踐的轉移。

segments.sourceText: Recent studies further suggest that involving students as game designers promotes deeper learning. Designing games requires analysing, organising, and creatively applying content, fostering imagination and theoretical understanding (Romero et al., 2019; Zaw Oo et al., 2024). In sustainability education, students who designed games reported enhanced creativity, skill development, and stronger content engagement (Mercer et al., 2017).

segments.sourceText: Collaborative learning is an instructional approach where students work in small groups to solve problems, complete tasks, or create products and has been shown to enhance academic performance and teamwork-related competencies in higher education (Jaiswal et al., 2021). Rooted in sociocultural theory, collaborative learning conceptualises knowledge as socially constructed through interaction and mutual exchange, supporting cognitive and motivational development (Lenkauskaitė et al., 2020).

translation.faithfulZh: 協作學習是一種教學方法，學生以小組的形式工作，以解決問題、完成任務或創造產品，並已被證明可以提高高等教育中的學習成績和團隊合作相關的能力（Jaiswal et al.，2021）。 植根於社會文化理論，協作學習將知識概念化為透過互動和相互交流構建的社會構建，支援認知和動機發展（Lenkauskaitė 等，2020）。
translation.plainZh: 協作學習涉及小組工作，以解決問題、完成任務或創造產品、提高高等教育的學習成績和團隊合作技能。 借鑑社會文化理論，它將知識視為透過互動和交流建立的，促進了認知和動機的成長。
translation.generatedBy: Chrome on-device AI via Codex batch pipeline

segments.sourceText: Collaborative creativity extends this foundation, focusing on co-constructing novel and valuable ideas through social interaction. Creativity, defined as the ability to produce original ideas and solve problems, thrives in open, reflective, and nonlinear environments (Glăveanu & Beghetto, 2021; Sternberg, 2009). As innovation and collaboration are core workplace competencies, fostering collaborative creativity through project-based learning is crucial for linking theory with practice (Baruah & Paulus, 2019; Thornhill-Miller et al., 2023).

translation.faithfulZh: 協作創造力擴充套件了這一基礎，專注於透過社互動動共同構建新穎和有價值的想法。 創造力，定義為產生原創想法和解決問題的能力，在開放、反思和非線性環境中蓬勃發展（Glăveanu & Beghetto, 2021; Sternberg, 2009）。 由於創新和協作是工作場所的核心能力，透過專題式學習來培養協作創造力對於將理論與實踐連結起來至關重要（Baruah & Paulus，2019；Thornhill-Miller et al.，2023）。
translation.plainZh: 協作創造力建立在協作學習的基礎上，專注於透過社互動動共同開發新的和有用的想法。 創造力，定義為產生原創想法和解決問題，在開放、反思和非線性環境中蓬勃發展。 由於創新和協作在工作場所至關重要，透過專題式學習培養協作創造力對於將理論與實際應用連結起來至關重要。

segments.sourceText: Recent studies illustrate that collaborative creativity thrives in social, exploratory, and task-driven environments (Barrett et al., 2021). translation.plainZh: 研究表明，協作創造力在社交、鼓勵探索和專注於任務的環境中效果最好。 與個人工作相比，小組工作產生更廣泛的想法，並激發思想、反思和知識共享。

segments.sourceText: The learning design integrated two pedagogical frameworks: the educational principles of health promotion (Naidoo & Wills, 2016) and Romero et al’.s (2019) iterative, needsbased game design model rooted in design thinking. The first framework guided the content structure, ensuring students progressed from understanding theories to applying them through needs assessment, intervention design, and evaluation. The second framework informed the design process, guiding students to iteratively analyse user needs, prototype, test, and refine their educational board games. Together, these frameworks aligned theoretical and procedural learning, linking health promotion competencies with creative, user-centred problem-solving relevant to real-world contexts.

segments.sourceText: Guided by these frameworks, the semester was structured into three phases (Figure 1). The first phase (Weeks 1–9) focused on theoretical foundations through lectures and discussions on health promotion principles, behaviour theories, and global strategies. The second (Weeks 10–11) developed planning skills through needs assessments and intervention design. The final phase (Weeks 12–18) centred on co-creative application, where students worked in groups of 6–7 to design educational board games for elementary students. Each group selected a specific health theme (e.g. balanced diet, infectious disease prevention, air pollution prevention), conducted audience analysis, defined learning objectives, and created game mechanics and storylines to communicate health messages. segments.sourceText: A guest expert in game-based education, along with a pre-developed learning handbook served as key instructional supports to enhance the co-creative learning process. The expert, a manager at a Taiwanese board game development company with expertise in educational game design and teacher training, provided practical insights into educational game mechanics and real-world implementation strategies, bridging theory with practice. Complementing this, the instructor prepared a learning handbook to scaffold student collaboration and design thinking throughout the project. Research indicates that inadequate teamwork can undermine the effectiveness of co-creative game-based projects, highlighting the need for explicit guidance in communication and coordination strategies (Lee et al., 2023). The handbook was organised into four main modules corresponding to the course phases: (1) teamwork and task allocation, (2) health promotion planning, (3) revision and preparation, and (4) implementation and reflection. Each module provided step-by-step guidance, templates, and examples to scaffold collaboration and game design for health education (Appendix A). In addition, taskspecific checklists were provided to monitor progress and ensure alignment with the intended intervention logic. Together, these supports strengthened students’ conceptual understanding, teamwork, and design coherence.

segments.sourceText: All the questionnaire items were reviewed by six experts with backgrounds in health promotion and teaching practice. A pre-test was conducted with 50 students from other cohorts to evaluate clarity and item performance. Content validity was assessed using a 4-point relevance scale and item-level content validity indices (I-CVI) ranged from 0.83 to 1.00, indicating strong expert agreement. segments.sourceText: This study examined the effects of a co-creative GBL intervention on two key outcomes – student engagement and collaborative creativity – while exploring potential variations across students with different academic standings and motivational levels. These aims align with the study’s two research questions, both of which were supported by the findings. The results confirmed significant overall improvements in engagement and collaborative creativity, providing empirical support for the educational value of cocreative GBL in health promotion education. These results extend prior research on the motivational and cognitive benefits of game-based pedagogies (Zhang & Yu, 2022), and highlight the additional value of positioning students as game designers rather than solely as players (Romero et al., 2019; Zaw Oo et al., 2024). This participatory approach, as emphasised by Lee et al. (2023) and Romero et al. (2019), fosters deeper learning by integrating metacognitive reflection, content transformation, and creative problemsolving.

translation.faithfulZh: 本研究檢查了共同創造性 GBL 干預對兩個關鍵結果——學生參與和協作創造力的影響——同時探索了不同學術地位和動機水平的學生的潛在差異。 這些目標與研究的兩個研究問題一致，這兩個問題都得到了研究結果的支援。 結果證實了參與度和協作創造力的整體顯著改善，為共同創造性 GBL 在健康促進教育中的教育價值提供了實證支援。 這些結果擴充套件了先前對基於遊戲教學的動機和認知益處的研究（Zhang & Yu, 2022），並強調了將學生定位為遊戲設計師而不僅僅是玩家的額外價值（Romero et al.，2019； ZAW Oo et al.，2024）。 正如 Lee et al. segments.sourceText: Specifically, subgroup analyses indicated that while engagement gains were consistent across all groups, improvements in collaborative creativity were more pronounced among students with lower academic performance or motivation. This suggests that co-creative GBL may particularly empower less confident learners by providing shared responsibility and tangible creative outcomes that enhance agency and participation. From a sociocultural perspective (Vygotsky & Cole, 1978), cocreation can be understood as constituting authentic, interaction-rich environments for joint meaning-making, aligning with Glăveanu and Beghetto’s (2021) view of creativity as cultural participation. Co-creative GBL’s concrete outputs, shared responsibilities, and peer interdependence may particularly benefit learners with limited participation in traditional settings, enhancing their agency and participation within a community of practice (Wenger, 1998). Similar benefits for such learners have been reported in structured collaborative learning (Gillies, 2016), with more recent studies in design-based and co-creative learning contexts highlighting comparable patterns of learner engagement and agency (Lee et al., 2023; Pan et al., 2021). In this study, audience-specific deliverables, such as educational board games for elementary students, acted as ‘tangible anchors’ (Brown, 2009), enabling the translation of abstract health concepts into actionable educational tools that strengthened students’ ability to communicate complex health messages effectively.

translation.faithfulZh: 具體來說，亞組分析表明，雖然所有群體的參與度提高是一致的，但在學習成績或動機較低的學生中，協作創造力的提高更為明顯。 這表明，共同創造性的 GBL 可以透過提供共同的責任和有形的創造性結果來增強代理和參與度，從而特別賦予不太自信的學習者權力。 從社會文化的角度來看（Vygotsky & Cole, 1978），共同創造可以被理解為構成了真實的、豐富的互動豐富的環境，以共同創造意義，與 Glăveanu 和 Beghetto 的 (2021) 對創造力作為文化的看法保持一致 參與。 共同創造的 GBL 的具體產出、共同責任和同伴相互依賴可能特別有利於在傳統環境中參與有限的學習者，增強他們的能動性和在實踐社羣中的參與（Wenger，1998）。 在結構化協作學習中也報告了此類學習者的類似好處（Gillies，2016 年），最近在基於設計和共同創造性學習環境的研究中強調了學習者參與和代理的可比模式（Lee et al.，2023； Pan et al.，2021）。 在這項研究中，特定受眾的可交付成果，例如針對小學生的教育棋盤遊戲，充當了「有形的錨」（Brown，2009），能夠將抽象的健康概念轉化為可操作的教育工具，以增強學生有效傳達複雜健康資訊的能力。

segments.sourceText: This study has several limitations. First, the sample was limited to one course in a single institution. Additionally, the relatively small number of students in some subgroups (e.g. by academic standing or motivation level) constrains the generalisability of the findings. Second, the study did not include a control group. Therefore, the observed improvements in engagement and collaborative creativity cannot be attributed solely to the co-creative GBL intervention; similar gains might have emerged through other concurrent learning activities or natural course progression. Third, because the surveys were administered by the course instructors, students may have provided socially desirable responses despite assurances of confidentiality. Fourth, the wording of the engagement and collaborative creativity items was adapted across the three measurement points to ensure contextual relevance to each learning phase. Although this maintained conceptual consistency, it may have introduced slight variations in item interpretation over time.

abstract.faithfulZh: 從文化心理學和社會心理學的角度對創造力的研究挑戰個人主義創造力的概念，認為社會互動、交流和協作是創造力的關鍵要素。 在最近的工作中，人們提出了創造性的合作，將受眾、材料、具體的行動和創造性活動和環境的歷史社會文化可供性“分配”，從而擴充套件了創造性合作的潛力，超出了直接的人際互動和參與的例項。 音樂表演、即興創作和作曲可以被視為創造性合作的典範“實驗室”，透過觀眾、材料、具體行動和歷史社會文化的可供性和限制的結合元素。 本文報告了對音樂中的創造性協作和協作創造力的系統文獻回顧的結果。 我們試圖確定目前與音樂中的這些術語和概念相關的調查結果、方法和環境。 研究結果表明，研究主要在高等教育、專業發展和專業實踐中進行，導致了一種新興的興趣現象，即協作創造性學習。 音樂流派是爵士樂、流行、西方古典、當代和世界音樂，跨越作曲、即興演奏和表演的音樂過程。 高等教育和專業發展環境的研究側重於確定那些支援學習的實踐，而不是協作創造性方法的性質或創造性合作的結果。 參與者主要是男性，樣本量較小。 方法論主要是定性的，重點是使用觀察、訪談和反思性日記方法的案例研究。 進一步的研究領域包括：研究創造性協作的性別化方法、協作創造力和協作創造性學習； 使用更多樣化的研究方法、方法和技術，包括大規模定量研究和基於藝術和藝術的方法； 以及對更多樣化的音樂環境的調查。

abstract.originalText: Background: Despite the support in primary education that student-designed games enhance student contextualisation of skills and tactics, there has been little support in secondary education,
abstract.faithfulZh: 背景：儘管在小學教育中支援學生設計的遊戲增強了學生對技能和策略的背景化，但中學教育幾乎沒有支援，也沒有任何探索這些主張的實證研究。 本文試圖重新點燃這些信念，並探討學生設計的遊戲在英語中學中的使用。 目的：詳細介紹中學生設計自己的遊戲的班級，並調查他們對遊戲製作過程的反應。 方法：英國一所學校的兩班男孩（14-16 歲）參加了這項研究。 每個班級分為三個教師選擇的團隊，每週參加一節課，每節課持續 40 分鐘，持續七週。 課程調整為學生提供四個發展階段：一個為期 2 周的基於圖書館的規劃和 wiki 建設階段； 1 周的戶外修改和 Wiki 更新階段； 三週的遊戲試用 wiki 最佳化階段； 以及 1 周的遊戲和 wiki 最終確定階段。 在這個時間範圍內，所涉及的學生被挑戰設計一種入侵遊戲，該遊戲將在隨後的單元中進行。 資料包括：教師教學後反思、教授研究人員和現場參與者之間的訪談、維基的觀察和分析。 資料分析在三個層面進行。 第一個方面是教師-研究人員立即和持續，以滿足學生的“當場”學習需求。 其次，教授-研究員幫助教師研究人員進行系統的收集、組織和分析。 第三，研究團隊在收集和寫作過程中分析和批評資料進行同行彙報。 結果：我們發現學生“購買”了遊戲製作過程，獲得了包容性的聲音並作為團隊合作。 此外，他們立即尋求受大眾媒體影響的創新，並與他人分享想法和學習，從而使他們能夠排除有問題的技能。 然而，看著其他人未能正確玩這些遊戲會引起學生的挫敗感。 結論：我們得出的結論是，學生設計的遊戲“釋放”了孩子們在他們自己的發展水平上定義競爭。 本文表明，透過信任學生並支援他們在他們玩的遊戲中發揮創造力，可以深入瞭解學生應用他們的體育知識的過程的過程。

abstract.faithfulZh: 自決理論 (SDT) 在理解和增強各種環境中的動機方面具有實證支援，包括教育環境。 Niemac 和 Ryan 強調，在課程設計中使用 SDT 可以使內部因果關係的更強程度更能實現課程作業。 以 SDT 為基礎的一種課程設計方法是 Gameful 學習——構建支援內在動機的任務，主要是增加自主性而不是學習。 遊戲化教室 (GC) 可能會提供比最低限度的學生獲得及格分數所需的作業和分數，從而允許學生選擇要追求的專案。 需要進一步的研究來檢查學生的動機在 GC 和非遊戲化課堂 (NGC) 之間的不同程度。 當前研究的目的是確定 GC 中的學生是否比 NGC 的學生更有內在動力。 學生在學期開始和結束時使用 GC 設計 (n = 24) 或 NGC 設計 (n = 26) 參加本科運動機能學課程，並在學期開始和結束時完成了一項源自內在動機量表和測試焦慮問卷的線上調查。 在 GC 中，學生從零分開始，並獲得了多項作業，困難重重以達到他們想要的成績。 NGC 使用了傳統的 100% 成績範圍，只需要作業和考試，學生會因不充分或不準確的反應而失去分數。 經過分析，發現 GC 中的學生對自主權和能力的看法高於 NGC 的學生。 這些差異隨時間存在的地方以及其他分量表的差異將進一步討論。 因此，尋求提高學生積極性和參與度的教育工作者可能會將遊戲化視為一種適當的方法。

abstract.faithfulZh: 實現更大創造力和協作的潛在途徑是透過在教育和研究中增加藝術和科學、技術、工程和數學 (STEM) 的整合。 這種方法在美國國家論壇上一直是越來越多的討論，是科學、技術、工程和數學以及藝術與設計 (STEAM) 教育運動的基礎。 與 STEM 領域（或反之亦然）發展真實的藝術整合具有挑戰性，特別是在高等教育中，傳統的學科結構和激勵措施可能會阻礙綜合專案的建立。 衡量和評估此類整合工作的結果可能會更具挑戰性，因為傳統指標不一定會為學生和教師創造新的機會，並且可能會在很長一段時間內（職業）產生最大的影響。 在德雷克塞爾大學，我們建立了 Expressive & Creative Interaction Technologies (Excite) 中心，作為一個獨立的學院，以追求和實現這種跨學科藝術與 STEM 的合作，特別是與外部藝術和教育合作伙伴。 在本次展望論文中，我們重點介紹了此類外部合作產生的一系列專案和成果，包括與專業藝術家的研究生研究、本科生工作經驗以及針對 12 年級 (K-12) 學生的 Steam 教育計劃。 雖然每個專案都有自己的特定目標和結果，但我們相信它們共同證明了這種綜合跨學科方法對所有學習水平都有影響力並具有潛在的變革性。

abstract.faithfulZh: 簡介 數字化和遊戲化為設計生物課程提供了許多增強動力的機會。 例如，數字化、遊戲化的學習環境可以透過提供豐富的體驗來增強課程。 這些課程可能會提供在學習活動中見證流動的機會。 對於學習者來說，流動會受到感知的自主、能力和相關性的積極影響。 然而，以前對生物課程的研究並沒有關注基本需求滿意度對數字學習環境中流動體驗的影響。 方法 為了解決這一研究差距，我們利用動物運動系統的主題，研究了學生在處理數字化、遊戲化的學習環境時的感知自主、能力和相關性，作為其流動體驗的可能預測因素。 教學單元的主題集中在動物的運動系統上。 我們的樣本包括 161 名學生（46.6% 的女性），從六年級到八年級。 評估了學生對基本需求和流動經驗的感知滿意度。 結果和討論結果證實了感知的自主權和感知能力作為學生流動體驗的預測因素。 然而，感知相關性對流動體驗沒有影響。 我們的研究結果與當前的研究狀態一致，並被證明與之前的結果大致一致。

abstract.faithfulZh: 目的 本文的目的是討論一種新穎的生命週期教育促進可持續發展 (ESD)，讓學生成為“設計思想家”。 設計/方法/方法 介紹了一個關於大學生建立、開發和使用教育遊戲的案例研究。 本文在 Kolb 的體驗式學習和動態匹配模型、Perry 的智力發展階段以及 Beech 和 Macintosh 的過程學習模型中討論了案例研究。 使用的資料來自玩遊戲的學生和設計遊戲的學生的問卷回饋。 進一步的定性回饋是從參與玩學生建立的遊戲的當地學校收集的。 調查結果 總體而言，學生們對評估做出了積極的反應，並希望看到更多此類評估。 他們喜歡所涉及的創造力和開發遊戲的過程。 對於大多數測量的技能組，大多數學生髮現他們的技能略有提高。 許多學生覺得他們學到了很多關於有效傳播科學的知識。 參與玩學生建立的遊戲的學童發現它們具有不同程度的有效性，作為依賴遊戲的引人入勝的學習工具。 原創性/價值 本文為 ESD 提供了一種新方法，該方法將以學習者為中心的安排融入遊戲創作、交付、玩耍和迴歸創作的整個生命週期中。 這些遊戲可以用作增強學童知識和影響行為的工具，同時提高學校的 ESD 能力。 該評估還有助於在學術和地方社羣之間建立重要聯絡，以促進可持續發展。

abstract.faithfulZh: 簡介 應用實踐經驗是公共衛生碩士課程的重要組成部分。 本研究的目的是檢查學生對他們在提供應用實踐機會的 MPH 課程中發展的技能和專業知識的看法。 方法 在 2008 年至 2018 年期間參加該課程的 236 名學生中，獲得了 212 人的電子郵件地址，104 人完成了同意書。 同意後，使用快速定性分析方法對反思論文進行去識別和分析。 這些論文涉及學生的學習經驗和公共衛生教育委員會 (Ceph) 設定的 MPH 課程能力的應用。 演繹和歸納分析鏡頭用於確定每個學生的關鍵經驗教訓。 使用作業說明和 Ceph 能力建立了用於論文分析的半結構化指南和矩陣。 結果 儘管反思論文分配因年而異，但在學生的反思中觀察到了共同點。 關鍵主題包括將理論轉化為實踐、導航公共衛生實踐的複雜環境、技能培養、批判性自我反思、遇到的挑戰以及促進專案成功的因素。 學生報告發展了實用技能，例如規劃獨立研究（例如，準備機構審查委員會 (IRB) 提交、諮詢教師和其他專家）、確定在圖表審查和電子病歷分析期間提取資料的現實方法，以及為不同的利益相關者和受眾傳播調查結果。 學生們還報告說，加強了溝通、團隊合作和解決問題等跨領域技能，這些技能有助於駕馭權力動態和平衡相互競爭的利益和期望。 學生在駕馭公共衛生實踐的動態時探索了他們作為公共衛生專業人員的身份。 結論 應用實踐經驗是知識和技能獲取的寶貴工具。 此外，它為學生提供了一個機會，讓他們參與到各自社羣合作伙伴的獨特組織文化中，並加深了他們對進行有意義的社羣參與研究的複雜性的理解。 意義 本研究證明了分析學生的批判性自我反思作為探索未來公共衛生專業人員時探索學習經驗的工具的效用。 這些發現可以幫助教育工作者設計未來的應用實踐經驗。

abstract.faithfulZh: 遊戲化的主要目的，即在現實世界中出於非遊戲目的實施遊戲設計元素，是為了促進人類對給定活動的動機和表現。 先前的研究雖然不是完全確定的，但通常支援這一目標的假設。 然而，以前的研究經常將遊戲化視為一種通用結構，忽略了許多不同的遊戲設計元素可能導致應用非常多樣化的事實。 基於自決理論框架，我們展示了一項使用線上模擬環境的隨機對照研究的結果。 我們刻意改變遊戲設計元素的不同配置，並對其對基本心理需求的滿足的影響進行分析。 我們的結果表明，徽章、排行榜和績效圖對能力的積極影響需要滿意度以及感知的任務意義，而化身、有意義的故事和隊友會影響社會相關性的經歷。 然而，感知到的決策自由不能按預期受到影響。 我們將這些發現解釋為對我們的主要假設的普遍支援，即遊戲化本身並不有效，但特定的遊戲設計元素具有特定的心理影響。 討論了進一步研究的後果，特別是治療檢查的重要性。

abstract.originalText: This meta-analysis was conducted to systematically synthesize research findings on effects of gamification on cognitive, motivational, and behavioral learning outcomes. Results from random effects models
abstract.faithfulZh: 這項薈萃分析旨在系統地綜合對遊戲化對認知、動機和行為學習結果的影響的研究結果。 隨機效應模型的結果顯示，遊戲化對認知的顯著小影響（g = .49, 95% CI [0.30, 0.69], k = 19, n = 1686), 動機 (g = .36, 95% CI) [0.18, 0.54], k = 16, n = 2246) 和行為學習結果 (g = .25, 95% CI [0.04, 0.46], k = 9, n = 951)。 雖然遊戲化對認知學習結果的影響在對採用高度方法嚴謹的研究的子拆分分析中是穩定的，但對動機和行為結果的影響不太穩定。 鑑於效應量的異質性，進行了調節分析以檢查遊戲小說、社互動動、對照組的學習安排，以及情境、上下文和方法調節因素，即時間週期、研究背景、隨機化、設計 和儀器。 包含遊戲小說和社互動動是遊戲化對行為學習結果影響的重要調節因素。 將遊戲小說納入和將競爭與協作相結合在促進行為學習結果的遊戲化中特別有效。 分裂分析的結果表明，競爭增強的競爭影響也可能對動機學習結果有效。 結果表明，目前在實證研究中實施的遊戲化是一種有效的教學方法，儘管促成遊戲化的因素仍有些未解決，尤其是對於認知學習結果。

abstract.faithfulZh: 本研究調查了影響團隊創造性表現的一些因素之間的多維關係，包括教育環境中的創造力、協作、多樣性和自主性。 231 (231) 名資訊學大學生在團隊中工作了整個學期，並使用自願的評估技術對他們的專案進行了創造性評估。 使用自舉的結構方程建模和路徑分析用於分析收集的資料並檢查關係。 根據結果，團隊的創造性多樣性與他們的創造性表現有顯著的正相關關係，而成員的聚合個人創造力並沒有產生顯著的影響。 團隊成員之間的協作對團隊的創造性輸出產生了積極影響，也部分調節了創意多樣性和創造性表現之間的關係。 成員的自主權與他們的創造力顯著相關，然而，在團隊層面，自主權和創造性表現之間沒有顯著關係。 討論了理論和實踐意義，並提出了未來的研究方向。

abstract.summaryZh: 本文討論了工作未來帶來的教育挑戰，研究了“21 世紀的技能”、他們的構思、評估和價值化。 最後，我們簡要討論了未來研究和人工智慧和虛擬現實等新技術帶來的機會。
abstract.faithfulZh: 本文討論了工作未來帶來的教育挑戰，研究了“21 世紀的技能”、他們的構思、評估和價值化。 它特別關注被稱為“4C”的關鍵軟技能能力：創造力、批判性思維、協作和溝通。 在每個 C 的部分中，我們在個人績效水平上概述了個人績效水平的評估，然後重點關注對可以在機構層面（即在學校、大學、專業培訓計劃等）中衡量的 4C 發展的系統性支援的不太常見的評估。 然後，我們介紹了被稱為“標籤化”的官方評估和認證過程，建議將其作為建立對 4C 的公開信任評估和促進其文化價值化的解決方案。 接下來，介紹“國際能力發展研究所 21 世紀技能框架”的兩個變體。 這些綜合系統中的第一個允許評估和標記 4C 的發展在多大程度上得到正規教育計劃或機構的支援。 第二個評估非正式的教育或培訓經驗，例如玩遊戲。 我們討論了 4C 之間的重疊以及教學和制度化的挑戰，這兩種方法都可以透過採用 4C 的動態互動主義模型來幫助——有趣地命名為“Crea-Critical-Collab-ication”——用於教學和政策促進 目的。 最後，我們簡要討論了未來研究和人工智慧和虛擬現實等新技術帶來的機會。

abstract.faithfulZh: 遊戲化是指在非遊戲環境中使用遊戲屬性。 衛生專業教育工作者越來越多地轉向遊戲化以最佳化學生的學習成果。 然而，對遊戲化的概念及其可能的工作機制知之甚少。 這篇綜述的重點是遊戲化方法有效性和應用所選博弈屬性的理論理由的經驗證據。 我們系統地搜尋了多個資料庫，幷包括所有評估衛生專業教育中游戲屬性使用情況的實證研究。 在最初確定的 5044 篇文章中，有 44 篇符合納入標準。 未報告使用遊戲化的負面結果。 幾乎所有研究都包括評估屬性（n = 40），主要與衝突/挑戰屬性（n = 27）相結合。 八項研究表明，這種特定的組合增加了學習材料的使用，有時會改善學習成果。 進行了相對較少的研究來解釋使用遊戲屬性的機制（n = 7）。 我們的研究結果表明，可以透過使用遊戲化來改善衛生專業教育的學習成果，尤其是在使用改善學習行為和對學習態度的遊戲屬性時。 然而，大多數研究缺乏明確定義的對照組，沒有應用和/或報告理論來理解潛在的過程。 未來的研究應該闡明遊戲化教育干預的潛在機制，並探索可以縱向方式使用定義明確的對照組解釋這些干預措施對學習結果的影響的理論。 在這樣做的基礎上，我們可以在現有理論的基礎上，對如何為正確的教育環境和正確的學生型別選擇正確的遊戲元素有一個實際和全面的理解。

abstract.faithfulZh: 儘管許多研究都集中在在教育中實施遊戲化的潛力，但現有文獻對其有效性仍然沒有定論。 為了理解在線上學習環境中實現遊戲設計元素的有效性的相互矛盾的發現，本文透過解決三個漏洞來補充可用的研究主體。 我們（1）從自決理論的角度分析了遊戲化的潛在動機過程，從而考慮了各種遊戲設計實現的動機效應； (2) 經驗評估隨時間推移的細微動機變化，以及 (3) 考慮了遊戲化動機效應的潛在個體差異。 在 15 周的時間裡，我們進行了四次調查，以衡量學生 (n = 40) 的動機水平的可能演變，以響應與在大學課程中使用的 Google + 社羣中實施的需求支援遊戲元素進行互動。 參與者的自主和受控動機是曲線線性的，顯示出令人驚訝的向上趨勢在學期末的向上傾向的下降趨勢。 他們可控的動機始終保持穩定。 結果說明了動機過程的個體性質的重要性、敏感的縱向動機測量的重要性以及實施的遊戲元素設計特徵的相關性。 我們透過在設計遊戲化時使用理論鏡頭展開辯論，併為未來的研究提供途徑來結束本文。

abstract.faithfulZh: 在藝術和設計教育中，動機和創造性表現在設計技能中的作用對設計學生具有巨大的意義。 因此，教師的教學策略至關重要。 在這些策略中，基於設計的學習 (DBL) 是整合設計原則、解決問題技能和創造性思維的重要教學過程之一，以使學生參與動手、真實的學習體驗。 本研究旨在調查 DBL 對學生在藝術和設計教育中的動機、創造力和設計技能的影響。 在喀山聯邦大學和喀山州立文化研究所對 207 名專門從事藝術和設計教育的參與者進行了測試前和測試後的實驗研究。 採用非機率抽樣，他們被分配到一個實驗（使用 DBL 治療；105 名學生）和一個對照（傳統教學；102 名學生）組。 研究結果表明，實驗組明顯優於對照組，而在動機、創造力和設計技能的發展中，組和性別之間沒有觀察到顯著的相互作用。 此外，成就動機被發現顯著影響創造性的表現和設計技能。 這項研究為教育工作者和研究人員提供了寶貴的資源，因為它為培養學生在藝術和設計教育領域的創造性表現提供了見解。

abstract.summaryZh: 這項薈萃分析旨在研究和比較遊戲化和基於遊戲的學習在學習成就和動機方面的效率。 依賴於外部或內部因素以及與動機內化相關的荒謬環境對浸入的依賴影響了對學習成就和動機的穩定性影響。
abstract.faithfulZh: 這項薈萃分析旨在研究和比較遊戲化和基於遊戲的學習在學習成就和動機方面的效率。 假設遊戲化和基於遊戲的學習對學習成就和動機產生不同的影響。 對基於遊戲的學習（ES = 0.54, 95% CI [0.38, 0.70]）的學習成績的影響比遊戲化（ES = 0.85, 95% CI [0.32, 1.37]）。 遊戲化對動機的總體影響（ES = 0.77, 95% CI [0.53, 1.01]）比基於遊戲的學習（ES = 0.60, 95% CI [0.42, 0.78]）。 遊戲化對內在動機（ES = 0.64, 95% CI [0.37, 0.91]）的影響較小但更穩定的影響（ES = 0.92, 95% CI） [0.50, 1.34]）。 基於遊戲的學習對外在動機（ES = 0.56, 95% CI [0.35, 0.77]）的影響較小但更穩定的影響（ES = 0.62, 95% CI） [0.12, 1.13]）。 主要結論是遊戲化和基於遊戲的學習，作為兩種不同的遊戲相關教學法，不同地影響學習成就、內在動機和外在動機。 依賴於外部或內部因素以及與動機內化相關的荒謬環境對浸入的依賴影響了對學習成就和動機的穩定性影響。

paper-05.title: Concept mapping as a critical thinking facilitator for generative AI-supported collaborative learning - Effects on diverse perceptions and cognitive levels
paper-05.sourceFileName: 5. Concept mapping as a critical thinking facilitator for generative AI-supported collaborative learning - Effects on diverse perceptions and cognitive levels.pdf

segments.sourceText: Collaborative learning has been identified as an effective means of enhancing students’ collaboration and problem-solving skills, as well as boosting their knowledge acquisition. The advent of generative artificial intelligence (GAI) has further provided a potential tool to facilitate diverse thinking in collaborative learning. However, previous studies have revealed that students experience cognitive overload due to the vast amount of available information. To address these issues, it is necessary to provide students with tools or supports for effectively employing GAI in collaborative learning. This study proposed a concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) mode, and evaluated its effectiveness through a quasi-experimental design. Participants were recruited from three high school classes. One class with 33 students served as the experimental group, adopting the CM-GAI-CL mode. Another class with 26 students served as control group 1, using the conventional GAI-supported collaborative learning (C-GAI- CL) mode. The third class with 29 students served as control group 2, using the conventional collaborative learning (C-CL) mode. The results suggested that the experimental group demonstrated significantly better learning achievement, collective efficacy, critical thinking tendencies, and problem-solving skills compared to both control groups.

translation.faithfulZh: 協作學習已被視為能提升學生合作與問題解決能力，並促進知識獲得的有效方法。生成式人工智慧（GAI）的出現，進一步提供了在協作學習中促進多元思考的潛在工具。然而，過往研究發現，學生可能因可取得的資訊量過於龐大而產生認知負荷。為處理這些問題，學生需要適當的工具或支援，才能在協作學習中有效運用 GAI。本研究提出「概念圖增強之生成式 AI 支援協作學習」（CM-GAI-CL）模式，並以準實驗設計評估其成效。參與者來自三個高中班級：33 人的實驗組採用 CM-GAI-CL；26 人的控制組一採用傳統生成式 AI 支援協作學習（C-GAI-CL）；29 人的控制組二則採用傳統協作學習（C-CL）。結果顯示，實驗組在學習成就、集體效能、批判思考傾向與問題解決能力方面，皆顯著優於兩個控制組。
translation.plainZh: 生成式 AI 能帶來很多想法，但資訊太多也可能讓學生不知如何整理。這項研究加入概念圖作為組織工具；與只有 AI 或只有協作學習相比，同時使用概念圖、AI 和協作的學生在多項學習成果上都表現較好。

segments.sourceText: Collaborative learning has been recognized as an important and effective approach to fostering students’ higher order thinking as well as their collaboration and communication competences (Markula & Aksela, 2022; Quines, 2017; Rorimpandey et al., 2022). In the past decades, several previous studies have demonstrated the effectiveness of engaging students in collaborative learning tasks (Knoche, 2022; Suendarti & Virgana, 2022). For example, in a reading and writing course, Marcos et al. (2020) employed cooperative learning to encourage students to collaboratively analyze and write in groups and develop their own perspectives, and found that this approach effectively enhanced their creative thinking. However, research has indicated that when students engage in group-based problem-solving tasks without sufficient guidance or support, they may feel confused or even experience anxiety during the learning process (Tsai & Wu, 2021). When conducting conventional collaborative learning activities, teachers often manage numerous students and groups, making it difficult to adequately address the needs of each group. As indicated by several scholars, collaborative learning facilitates social negotiation and shared knowledge construction; however, it may lack sufficient structure without appropriate scaffolding (Kokku et al., 2018; Tsai & Wu, 2021); that is, providing timely guidance or immediate feedback or guidance to individual collaborative learning groups remains a critical challenge in educational contexts (Hsu et al., 2023; Kokku et al., 2018; Tsai & Wu, 2021).

segments.sourceText: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) is regarded as a potential solution to address this issue due to its ability to provide diverse and immediate responses, reducing teachers’ workloads while offering guidance or suggestions to each group of students during the collaborative learning process (Dwivedi et al., 2023; Fui-Hoon Nah et al., 2023). Nonetheless, scholars have proposed several concerns regarding adopting GAI in learning, including the provision of incorrect information and cognitive overload (Christensen et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2023). This implies that, during the GAI-supported collaborative leaning process, it may be necessary to provide additional scaffolding to help students organize what they have learned from the class and what they have derived from GAI (Hsu et al., 2023; Kasneci et al., 2023; Lin & Mubarok, 2021). In addition, GAI offers informational expansion and immediate feedback, yet it may increase cognitive load or introduce inaccurate content (Dwivedi et al., 2023; Zhang et al., 2023).

translation.faithfulZh: 生成式人工智慧 (GAI) 被認為是解決此問題的潛在解決方案，因為它能夠提供多樣化和即時的響應，減少教師的工作量，同時在協作學習過程中為每組學生提供指導或建議（Dwivedi et al.， 2023；Fui-Hoon Nah et al.，2023）。 儘管如此，學者們提出了一些關於在學習中採用 GAI 的擔憂，包括提供不正確的資訊和認知超載（Christensen et al.，2024；Zhang et al.，2023）。 這意味著，在 GAI 支援的協作傾向過程中，可能有必要提供額外的腳手架，以幫助學生組織他們從課堂上學到的東西以及他們從 GAI 中學到的東西（Hsu et al.，2023； Kasneci et al.，2023；林和穆巴羅克，2021）。 此外，GAI 提供資訊擴充套件和即時回饋，但它可能會增加認知負荷或引入不準確的內容（Dwivedi et al.，2023；Zhang et al.，2023）。

segments.sourceText: To address these complementary limitations, the present study integrated GAI and collaborative learning with a concept-mapping tool as a human-mediated cognitive scaffold. Concept mapping is such a cognitive tool that aids students in visualizing information (Novak, 1983), particularly as a collaborative learning tool for co-constructing knowledge (Shi et al., 2023; Tsourela et al., 2015). Numerous studies have confirmed that concept mapping is an effective tool for promoting meaningful learning (Shi et al., 2023). It helps students identify and evaluate the relationships, significance, and differences between knowledge, thereby enhancing learning efficiency (Evans & Jeong, 2023; Machado & Carvalho, 2020). That is, during the collaborative learning process, concept mapping serves as a metacognitive and organizational scaffold that structures AI-generated information, externalizes learners’ reasoning, and supports group regulation (Ma et al., 2023; Su & Zou, 2024). In this study, students were guided to construct concept maps using the designated tool during the GAI-supported collaborative learning process to ensure that knowledge organization reflected learners’ own cognitive processing instead of automated outputs.

translation.faithfulZh: 為了解決這些互補的侷限性，本研究將 GAI 和協作學習與作為人類介導的認知支架的概念對映工具整合在一起。 概念對映是一種幫助學生視覺化資訊的認知工具（Novak，1983），特別是作為共同構建知識的協作學習工具（Shi et al.，2023；Tsourela et al.， 2015）。 大量研究證實，概念對映是促進有意義學習的有效工具（Shi et al.，2023）。 它幫助學生識別和評估知識之間的關係、重要性和差異，從而提高學習效率（Evans & Jeong, 2023; Machado & Carvalho, 2020）。 也就是說，在協作學習過程中，概念對映是一個元認知和組織的支架，它構成了人工智慧生成的資訊，將學習者的推理外化，並支援群體監管（Ma et al.，2023；Su & Zou， 2024)。 在這項研究中，學生被引導在 GAI 支援的協作學習過程中使用指定的工具構建概念圖，以確保知識組織反映了學習者自己的認知處理，而不是自動輸出。
translation.plainZh: 在這項研究中，概念對映用於組織 AI 生成的資訊，反映學習者的認知處理，而不是依賴於自動化輸出。

segments.sourceText: Grounded in Social Cognitive Theory (Bandura, 1986, 2000), the integration of structured cognitive organization and collaborative regulation is expected to enhance learners’ collective efficacy, which in turn promotes strategic engagement in complex tasks. Such strategic and metacognitive engagement fosters the development of higher-order cognitive processes, particularly critical thinking tendencies and problem-solving skills (Barta et al., 2022; Lai & Hwang, 2014). Within this framework, collective efficacy functions as a motivational driver that strengthens engagement, supports higher-order thinking, and ultimately contributes to academic achievement and learning experiences. Improvements in these cognitive and motivational processes are subsequently translated into gains in academic achievement, while learners’ perceived learning experiences represent affective–cognitive evaluations emerging from successful task engagement and collaborative functioning (Avry et al., 2020; Fredricks et al., 2004; Schunk & DiBenedetto, 2020).

segments.sourceText: In the field of education, collaborative learning has been widely applied and is regarded as an effective instructional strategy for enhancing student learning (Gillies, 2003; Hron & Friedrich, 2003; Kokku et al., 2018). Several researchers have revealed that collaborative learning can significantly improve students’ academic performance (Rorimpandey et al., 2022; Suendarti & Virgana, 2022), collective efficacy (Gillies, 2019), critical thinking tendencies (Huang et al., 2017; Quines, 2017), as well as problem-solving and decision-making abilities (Knoche, 2022). These benefits can also be explained by Social Cognitive Theory, which emphasizes that learning occurs through social interaction and observational processes within a shared environment (Bandura, 1986, 2000). Building upon the foundations of collaborative learning, PBL has emerged as a structured approach that embodies its core principles. It is commonly regarded as a concrete form of collaborative learning, and is deeply inspired by the theory of social constructivism (Vygotsky, 1986). According to Vygotsky’s (1986) view of social constructivism, knowledge is constructed through social interaction, language communication, and collaborative activities in cultural contexts. In a PBL context, students discuss, reason, and share knowledge about real problems in small groups, and develop understanding and solutions through peer collaboration and reflection (Markula & Aksela, 2022; Tsai & Wu, 2021). This learning process strengthens learners’ active participation and realizes the key role of social interaction in cognitive development and knowledge construction.Krajcik and Shin’s (2014) framework of the key characteristics of PBL divides collaborative learning into different stages, namely a driving question, learning goals, scientific practices, collaboration, using technological tools, and creating an artefact, which help to enhance students’ problem-solving skills. Previous research has shown that engaging students in collaborative learning and PBL tasks can enhance not only their academic achievement but also their group self-efficacy, critical thinking tendencies, and problem-solving skills (Huang et al., 2017; Knoche, 2022; Ma et al., 2023).

translation.faithfulZh: 在教育領域，協作學習已被廣泛應用，被認為是增強學生學習的有效教學策略（Gillies，2003；Hron & Friedrich，2003；Kokku et al.，2018）。 一些研究人員表明，協作學習可以顯著提高學生的學習成績（Rorimpandey et al.，2022；Suendarti & Virgana，2022），集體效能（Gillies，2019），批判性思維趨勢 （Huang et al.，2017；Quines，2017），以及解決問題和決策能力（Knoche，2022）。 這些好處也可以用社會認知理論來解釋，它強調學習是透過共享環境中的社會互動和觀察過程發生的（Bandura，1986，2000）。 在協作學習的基礎上，PBL 已成為一種體現其核心原則的結構化方法。 它通常被認為是一種具體的協作學習形式，並深受社會建構主義理論的啟發（Vygotsky，1986）。 根據 Vygotsky (1986) 的社會建構主義觀點，知識是透過社會互動、語言交流和文化背景下的協作活動構建的。 在 PBL 背景下，學生在小組中討論、推理和分享有關實際問題的知識，並透過同行協作和反思來發展理解和解決方案

segments.sourceText: Although the benefits of collaborative learning have been well verified, and approaches such as PBL are grounded in collaborative principles, simply grouping students and asking them to work together does not necessarily ensure effective collaboration or positive learning outcomes (Boud & Bearman, 2024; Gillies, 2003). Researchers have noted that when students engage in group-based problem-solving tasks without expert guidance, they may feel confused or even experience anxiety (Tsai & Wu, 2021). In traditional teaching environments, providing timely and individualized guidance can be challenging for educators (Hsu et al., 2023). Hence, implementing effective scaffolding strategies and designing appropriate learning tasks are essential for creating a supportive environment that facilitates discussion and learning (Hron & Friedrich, 2003). In recent years, some researchers have suggested employing GAI systems, such as ChatGPT, as virtual mentors to support collaborative learning (Fui-Hoon Nah et al., 2023; Lai & Tu, 2024; Weng & Chiu, 2023).

translation.faithfulZh: 儘管協作學習的好處已經得到了很好的驗證，並且 PBL 等方法基於協作原則，簡單地將學生分組並要求他們一起工作並不一定能確保有效的協作或積極的學習成效（Boud & Bearman, 2024; Gillies, 2003）。 研究人員注意到，當學生在沒有專家指導的情況下從事基於小組的問題解決任務時，他們可能會感到困惑甚至感到焦慮（Tsai & Wu, 2021）。 在傳統的教學環境中，提供及時和個性化的指導對教育工作者來說可能具有挑戰性（Hsu et al.，2023）。 因此，實施有效的腳手架策略和設計適當的學習任務對於創造促進討論和學習的支援性環境至關重要（Hron & Friedrich，2003）。 近年來，一些研究人員建議聘請ChatGPT等GAI系統作為虛擬導師來支援協作學習（Fui-Hoon Nah et al.，2023；Lai & Tu，2024；Weng & Chiu， 2023)。

segments.sourceText: GAI, an AI technology capable of creating new content (e.g., text, images, or audio) based on input data, has recently become an important trend in the field of education (Chiu, 2023; Dwivedi et al., 2023). Large Language Models (LLMs) represent a core technological foundation of GAI in the domain of natural language processing, enabling the automated generation of coherent, contextually appropriate text based on extensive training on linguistic data (Kasneci et al., 2023). For example, ChatGPT, with its powerful language understanding and generation capabilities, can provide real-time interaction and question answering during the learning process, effectively assisting students with their knowledge construction (Jeon et al., 2023; Michel-Villarreal et al., 2023).

translation.faithfulZh: GAI 是一種能夠基於輸入資料建立新內容（例如，文字、影象或音訊）的 AI 技術，最近已成為教育領域的一個重要趨勢（Chiu，2023；Dwivedi et al.，2023）。 大型語言模型 (LLMS) 代表了 GAI 在自然語言處理領域的核心技術基礎，能夠基於對語言資料的廣泛培訓自動生成相干的、上下文適當的文字 (Kasneci et al., 2023)。 例如，ChatGPT 具有強大的語言理解和生成能力，可以在學習過程中提供實時互動和問答，有效地幫助學生構建知識（Jeon et al.，2023；Michel-Villarreal et al.， 2023)。

segments.sourceText: From the perspective of social constructivism, which emphasizes the co-construction of knowledge through social interaction, collaboration, and situated learning within meaningful contexts, the integration of GAI can enhance the diversity and depth of group discussions, thereby fostering students’ critical thinking and problem-solving abilities (Kasneci et al., 2023; Rudolph et al., 2023). Concept mapping can be understood as a metacognitive scaffolding tool that supports learners’ cognitive organization and self-regulation processes (Tsourela et al., 2015). From the perspective of Social Cognitive Theory (Bandura, 1986, 2000), such external cognitive supports may facilitate learners’ strategic engagement with complex tasks by helping them monitor, structure, and evaluate their knowledge construction processes. When integrated with collaborative learning, concept mapping may also enhance collective efficacy by enabling groups to externalize and coordinate their shared understanding. The extensive knowledge and diverse perspectives provided by GAI contribute to broadening the scope of discussions, encouraging students to engage in multifaceted thinking from various viewpoints. These diverse perspectives can then be incorporated into group discussions and problem-solving processes, thereby facilitating collaborative learning activities (Chen et al., 2023; Dwivedi et al., 2023; Neto et al., 2019). When students understand how they should work together, the potential for collaboration and learning is maximized (Gillies, 2003; Hron & Friedrich, 2003; Johnson & Johnson, 2009).

translation.faithfulZh: 從社會建構主義的角度，強調透過社會互動、協作和情境學習在有意義的背景下共同構建知識，增強了群體討論的多樣性和深度，從而培養學生的批判性思維和解決問題的能力。 （Kasneci et al.，2023；Rudolph et al.，2023）。 概念對映可以被理解為支援學習者的認知組織和自我調節過程的元認知腳手架工具（Tsourela et al.，2015）。 從社會認知理論（Bandura, 1986, 2000）的角度來看，這種外部認知支援可以透過幫助學習者監控、構建和評估他們的知識構建過程來促進他們與複雜任務的戰略接觸。 當與協作學習相結合時，概念對映還可以透過使群體能夠將其共同理解外部化和協調來增強集體效能。 GAI 提供的廣泛知識和不同的觀點有助於擴大討論的範圍，鼓勵學生從不同的角度進行多方面的思考。 然後可以將這些不同的觀點納入小組討論和解決問題的過程中，從而促進協作學習活動（Chen et al.，2023；Dwivedi et al.，2023； Neto et al.，2019）。 當學生了解他們應該如何合作時，協作和學習的潛力就最大限度地發揮了作用（Gillies，2003；Hron & Friedrich，2003；Johnson & Johnson，2009）。

segments.sourceText: Although GAI can generate convincing narratives, previous studies have pointed out that it suffers from the problem of “hallucination,” that is, it generates information that does not correspond to the truth, but is linguistically and logically fluent, which is very likely to mislead learners (Lee et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2023). For example, when asked about the social impact of sunset industries, GAI may fabricate non-existent industrial policies, misquote inaccurate cases, or misinterpret historical facts. This may reinforce students’ misperceptions if they do not have sufficient background knowledge or critical validation skills. Some studies have raised concerns regarding the application of GAI, particularly regarding the accuracy and reliability of the information it generates, as well as its tendency to produce both relevant and irrelevant content (Dwivedi et al., 2023; Michel-Villarreal et al., 2023). Consequently, it is crucial to support students in effectively integrating the knowledge they acquire, as mere knowledge acquisition is insufficient. The key lies in how students integrate, apply, and transform their knowledge (Machado & Carvalho, 2020; Shi et al., 2023). Otherwise, engaging in discussions and interactions with GAI may fail to produce meaningful learning outcomes, and could even impose an additional cognitive load on students. Therefore, providing appropriate learning scaffolding is essential when utilizing GAI for learning, as this improves the efficiency and effectiveness of students’ interactions with AI (Kasneci et al., 2023; Lin & Mubarok, 2021).

translation.faithfulZh: 雖然蓋伊可以產生令人信服的敘述，但之前的研究指出，它存在「幻覺」的問題，也就是說，它產生的資訊與真理不相符，但在語言和邏輯上是流暢的，這很可能誤導學習者 （Lee et al.，2024；Zhang et al.，2023）。 例如，當被問及日落產業的社會影響時，GAI 可能會捏造不存在的產業政策、錯誤引用不準確的案例或曲解歷史事實。 如果學生沒有足夠的背景知識或關鍵的驗證技能，這可能會加強學生的誤解。 一些研究對GAI的應用提出了關切，特別是它產生的資訊的準確性和可靠性，以及它產生相關和不相關內容的傾向（Dwivedi et al.，2023；Michel-Villarreal et al.， 2023)。 因此，支援學生有效整合他們獲得的知識至關重要，因為僅僅知識獲取是不夠的。 關鍵在於學生如何整合、應用和轉變他們的知識（Machado & Carvalho, 2020; Shi et al., 2023）。 否則，與 GAI 進行討論和互動可能無法產生有意義的學習成效，甚至可能會給學生帶來額外的認知負擔。 因此，在利用 GAI 進行學習時，提供適當的學習支架是必不可少的，因為這提高了學生與 AI 互動的效率和有效性（Kasneci et al.，2023；Lin & Mubarok，2021）。

segments.sourceText: Concept mapping is a knowledge organization tool consisting of nodes and connecting lines, where nodes represent concepts, and lines indicate the relationships between them (Novak, 1983). The use of concept mapping extends across various domains. In workplace management, it can be employed for strategic planning, problem solving, and idea communication (Yue et al., 2017). As for language education, concept mapping is used to organize and present complex textual content, as well as to support instructional strategies such as map completion and collaborative scaffolding (Su & Zou, 2024). Regarding mathematics education, teachers can utilize concept mapping to assist students in better understanding course content, thereby enhancing knowledge retention and application (Evans & Jeong, 2023). For instance, Lin et al. (2022) incorporated concept mapping into nursing courses to assist students in organizing and analyzing information, facilitating the integration of multidisciplinary theoretical knowledge. The results indicated that the experimental group demonstrated significantly higher academic performance and self-efficacy. Above all, the collaborative construction of concept mapping can serve as an effective approach to promoting learners’ knowledge construction (Shi et al., 2023; Tsourela et al., 2015).

(2022) 將概念對映整合到護理課程中，以幫助學生組織和分析資訊，促進多學科理論知識的整合。 結果表明，實驗組表現出明顯更高的學習成績和自我效能。 最重要的是，概念對映的協作構建可以作為促進學習者知識構建的有效方法（Shi et al.，2023；Tsourela et al.，2015）。

This is particularly beneficial for collaborative learning when students need to process substantial amounts of information, explore complex topics, or solve problems (Ma et al., 2023; Tsourela et al., 2015). Such a visual tool provides both structural and visual support (Novak, 1983), enabling students to more effectively utilize the extensive information offered by GAI.

segments.sourceText: Scholars have further indicated that concept mapping can serve as a metacognitive scaffolding tool, helping to reduce cognitive load, structure group interactions, and enhance the effectiveness of collaborative problem solving (Machado & Carvalho, 2020; Su & Zou, 2024). For example, in GAI-supported learning, concept maps can function as a shared external representation that helps learners formulate more purposeful prompts and questions, and critically evaluate information returned by the chatbot, thereby improving AI student interaction quality (Ye et al., 2025). Concept maps make learners’ conceptual structure explicit and revisable, prompting planning (what to include), monitoring (whether links are coherent), and evaluation (what is missing or unsupported) during knowledge construction (Novak, 1990). The cooperative learning literature further emphasizes that positive interdependence, individual accountability, promotive interaction, interpersonal and small-group skills, and group processing are essential dimensions that support effective collaborative learning outcomes (Johnson & Johnson, 2009; Machado & Carvalho, 2020). Aligning concept mapping with these cooperative-learning dimensions strengthens the theoretical rationale for its use in GAI-supported collaborative learning, because the shared map can operationalize interdependence and promote interaction while providing a concrete basis for accountability and group processing.

translation.faithfulZh: 學者們進一步指出，概念對映可以作為一種元認知的支架工具，有助於減少認知負荷、結構組互動，並增強協作解決問題的有效性（Machado & Carvalho, 2020; Su & Zou, 2024）。 例如，在 GAI 支援的學習中，概念圖可以充當共享的外部表示形式，幫助學習者制定更有目的的提示和問題，並批判性地評估聊天機器人返回的資訊，從而提高 AI 學生的互動品質（Ye et al.， 2025)。 概念圖使學習者的概念結構明確和可修改，促使計劃（包括什麼）、監控（無論連結是連貫的）以及在知識構建過程中的評估（缺失或不受支援的內容）（Novak，1990）。 合作學習文獻進一步強調，積極的相互依賴、個人責任、促進互動、人際和小組處理技能以及群體處理是支援有效協作學習成效的基本維度（Johnson & Johnson, 2009; Machado & Carvalho, 2020）。 將概念對映與這些合作學習維度保持一致，加強了其在 GAI 支援的協作學習中的使用的理論依據，因為共享地圖可以在實現相互依存關係和促進互動的同時，同時為問責制和群體處理提供具體的基礎。

segments.sourceText: From the cognitive load perspective, concept maps act as external representations that offload working-memory demands and stabilize complex relations so that learners can allocate more resources to schema construction and meaningful integration, rather than to keeping information “in mind” (Kirsh, 2010; Sweller, 1988). This same externalization can enhance AI-student interaction by providing a shared, persistent artifact that constrains prompts, reduces ambiguity, and supports iterative cycles of querying, critiquing, and revising (Azevedo & Hadwin, 2005; Kirsh, 2010). Research on AI-supported scaffolding has suggested that structured scaffolds paired with AI agents can improve comprehension and learning processes relative to unstructured use, which supports the design rationale for using concept maps as a prompt scaffold, rather than treating AI interaction as ad hoc questioning (Yan et al., 2025).

translation.faithfulZh: 從認知負荷的角度來看，概念圖作為外部表示，可以減輕工作記憶需求並穩定複雜的關係，從而使學習者可以將更多的資源分配給模式構建和有意義的整合，而不是將資訊「牢記在心」（Kirsh，2010；Sweller， 1988)。 這種相同的外部化可以透過提供共享的、持久的人工製品來增強 AI 學生的互動，該工件可以約束提示、減少歧義並支援查詢、批評和修改的迭代迴圈（Azevedo & Hadwin，2005； 基什，2010）。 對人工智慧支援的腳手架的研究表明，與人工智慧代理配對的結構化腳手架可以提高相對於非結構化使用的理解和學習過程，這支援了將概念圖用作及時支架的設計理由，而不是將AI互動視為臨時的 提問（Yan et al.，2025）。
translation.plainZh: 概念圖作為外部表示，透過穩定複雜的關係來減少認知負荷，釋放工作記憶。 這種外化透過提供一個明確的工件來闡明提示並支援迭代學習週期，從而增強了人工智慧學生的互動。 用概念圖構建人工智慧互動，而不是非結構化的質疑，可以提高理解和學習過程。

segments.sourceText: The participants in this study were second-year high school students (11th-grade students) from a school in central Taiwan, with an average age of 17. All participants, representing three classes, volunteered to take part in the study. In adherence to ethical guidelines stipulated by the Institutional Review Board, all participant data were anonymized, and students could withdraw from the study at any time without providing a reason. One class of 33 students served as the experimental group, another class of 26 students was assigned as control group 1, and the other class of 29 students was control group 2. The experimental group adopted the CM-GAI-CL mode, control group 1 employed the GAI-CL mode, and control group 2 utilized the C-CL mode. Previous studies have demonstrated that the optimal group size for collaborative learning is three students per group (Beghetto, 2016; Gillies, 2019; Hsu et al., 2009). Free grouping was adopted by referring to the suggestions of Hsu et al. (2009) and Hu et al. (2022), with three students in each group. This allowed students to form teams according to their familiarity or learning styles so as to promote natural cooperative interactions and discussion quality. None of the participants had prior learning experience of the course unit. A pretest was administered to ensure that all students had comparable prior knowledge related to sustainability before the experiment.

translation.faithfulZh: 本研究的參與者是來自臺灣中部一所學校的二年級高中生（11 年級學生），平均年齡為 17 歲。所有代表三個班級的參與者自願參加這項研究。 遵守機構審查委員會規定的道德準則，所有參與者資料均匿名化，學生可以隨時退出研究，而無需提供理由。 一班33名學生擔任實驗組，另一班26名學生為對照組1，另一班29名學生為對照組2。實驗組採用CM-GAI-CL模式，對照組1採用GAI-CL模式，對照組 2 使用 C-CL 模式。 先前的研究表明，協作學習的最佳群體規模是每組 3 名學生（Beghetto，2016；Gillies，2019；Hsu et al.，2009）。 透過參考 Hsu et al. (2009) 和 Hu et al. (2022) 的建議，採用了自由分組，每組有 3 名學生。 這使學生可以根據他們的熟悉度或學習方式組建團隊，以促進自然的合作互動和討論品質。 沒有一個參與者有課程單元的先前學習經驗。 進行了預測試，以確保所有學生在實驗前都具有與可持續性相關的可比先驗知識。

segments.sourceText: This study builds onKrajcik and Shin’s (2014) framework of the key characteristics of PBL. As illustrated in Fig. 1, the proposed CM-GAI-CL model includes five progressive stages designed not only to support academic development but also to foster students’ abilities to engage critically with sustainability issues, understand systemic complexity, and collaborate toward socially responsible solutions.

segments.section: 3.2. Concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) model
segments.sourceText: This study was conducted within the context of a course unit regarding a sustainable development issue, namely “sunset industries.” The topic was deliberately selected as a real-world, interdisciplinary sustainability challenge. It engages students in analyzing the socio-economic and environmental impacts of industrial decline and technological transformation. Through this issue, students examine how economic restructuring intersects with labor rights, ecological concerns, and policy-making, thereby promoting systems thinking. Concept mapping played a central role by helping students visualize the dynamic interconnections among technological advancement, economic policy, employment shifts, and cultural values. This process supported the construction of holistic, interconnected understandings of sustainability problems.

translation.faithfulZh: 這項研究是在一個關於可持續發展問題的課程單元的背景下進行的，即「日落行業」。 該主題被刻意選擇為現實世界的跨學科可持續性挑戰。 它讓學生分析工業衰退和技術轉型對社會經濟和環境的影響。 透過這個問題，學生研究經濟結構如何與勞動權利、生態問題和政策制定相交叉，從而促進系統思維。 概念對映透過幫助學生視覺化技術進步、經濟政策、就業轉變和文化價值觀之間的動態聯絡發揮了核心作用。 這一過程支援了對可持續性問題的整體、相互聯絡的理解。
translation.plainZh: 該研究是在一個專注於「日落工業」的課程單元中進行的，這是一個現實世界的可持續性挑戰。 它旨在透過分析工業衰退對社會經濟和環境的影響來培養學生的系統思維能力。 概念對映有助於視覺化技術、政策、就業和文化之間複雜的相互關係，幫助發展對可持續性問題的全面理解。

segments.section: 3.2. Concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) model
segments.sourceText: In the “Challenge and Goal Setting” stage, the teacher posed problem-based questions and guided students in understanding the learning objectives, ensuring a clear direction for the learning activity. According to Locke and Latham’s (2002) goal-setting theory, well-defined goals can enhance learners’ motivation and focus. The teacher had to not only convey information, but also guide students to examine the essence and underlying significance of the problem, fostering a comprehensive understanding of the core learning tasks. Subsequently, with the teacher’s guidance, students participated in group discussions to develop specific and achievable learning objectives. This process promoted active engagement, enabling students to share their perspectives and insights and reach a consensus. Through this collaborative effort, students gained a clear understanding of their roles and responsibilities in the learning process, thereby improving their focus and learning effectiveness. This enabled them to prepare to explore and construct knowledge by interacting with GAI in the subsequent stages.

translation.faithfulZh: 在「挑戰和目標設定」階段，教師提出基於問題的問題，引導學生理解學習目標，確保學習活動的明確方向。 根據 Locke 和 Latham (2002) 的目標設定理論，明確定義的目標可以增強學習者的動力和專注力。 教師不僅要傳達資訊，還要引導學生審視問題的本質和潛在意義，培養對核心學習任務的全面理解。 隨後，在教師的指導下，學生參加小組討論，以制定具體和可實現的學習目標。 這個過程促進了積極的參與，使學生能夠分享他們的觀點和見解並達成共識。 透過這種協作努力，學生們清楚地瞭解了他們在學習過程中的角色和責任，從而提高了他們的專注力和學習效果。 這使他們能夠準備透過在後續階段與 GAI 互動來探索和構建知識。
translation.plainZh: 在「挑戰和目標設定」階段，教師引導學生了解學習目標和問題的意義，與目標設定理論保持一致，以提高動力。 學生透過 GAI 互動開發了特定的目標，增強了參與度、建立共識並理解他們在未來知識構建中的作用。

segments.section: 3.2. Concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) model
segments.sourceText: In the “GAI Exploration” stage, students interacted with GAI to gather data and explore knowledge and information related to the questions. Throughout this process, the teacher guided students in effectively engaging with GAI through a series of steps: defining questions, requesting details for clarification, developing ideas, drilling down with follow-up inquiries, and verifying the accuracy of the collected information to make necessary adjustments. According to recommendations from previous studies (Banh & Strobel; Fui-Hoon Nah et al., 2023; Hsu et al., 2023), GAI is an emerging technological tool that requires users to follow specific guidelines for more effective interaction. In the example of the “sunset industry” issue, students might ask: “What are the characteristics of a sunset industry?” and “Could you give examples of sunset industries facing labor or environmental issues?” GAI not only provided abstract concepts such as market decline, technological backwardness, and lack of growth, but also supported them with explanations and concrete terms. Students were advised to make preliminary judgments on the correctness of the information provided by GAI. These interactions could help students develop skills of critical thinking and effectively asking questions, especially by evaluating the diverse viewpoints offered by GAI.

translation.faithfulZh: 在「GAI 探索」階段，學生與 GAI 互動以收集資料並探索與問題相關的知識和資訊。 在整個過程中，教師透過一系列步驟引導學生有效地與 GAI 互動：定義問題、要求澄清細節、制定想法、深入瞭解後續調查以及驗證收集的資訊的準確性以進行必要的調整。 根據先前研究的建議（Banh & Strobel；Fui-Hoon Nah et al.，2023；Hsu et al.，2023） 互動。 在「日落產業」問題的例子中，學生可能會問：「日落行業的特徵是什麼？」 「你能舉出日落行業面臨勞動力或環境問題的例子嗎？」 GAI 不僅提供了市場衰退、技術落後和缺乏增長等抽象概念，還提供瞭解釋和具體術語的支援。 建議學生對 GAI 提供的資訊的正確性做出初步判斷。 這些互動可以幫助學生培養批判性思維和有效提問的技能，特別是透過評估 GAI 提供的不同觀點。
translation.plainZh: 在「GAI探索」階段，學生透過結構化的探究過程，利用GAI收集資訊。 根據研究建議，學生定義問題，尋求澄清，並驗證 Gai 回答的準確性（例如，「日落行業的特徵是什麼？」）。 GAI 提供了抽象的概念和解釋，促使學生批判性地評估資訊並培養與不同觀點相關的批判性思維和提問技能。

segments.section: 3.2. Concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) model
segments.sourceText: In the “Knowledge Organization” stage, each group collaboratively used MindMaster to construct a concept map that organized the information gathered from GAI (see Fig. 2). MindMaster was selected for its collaborative features, specifically allowing multiple students to simultaneously edit and visualize concept maps in real time. Its limitations include reliance on stable internet access and a short learning curve for students unfamiliar with digital mapping tools. The students were guided to check the information from GAI and identify the relationships between the concepts underlying the information, such as “characteristics of sunset industries,” “labor protection,” and “environmental sustainability.” They then visualized the relationships by developing concept maps. The process of constructing a concept map was not only an integration of knowledge but also a test of students’ depth of understanding. This not only aided their own comprehension and memory, but also facilitated communication and discussion among group members. Therefore, constructing a concept map further promoted student communication and collaboration, ensuring that each member actively participated in knowledge construction.

translation.faithfulZh: 在「知識組織」階段，每個小組合作使用 Mindmaster 構建一個概念圖，組織從 GAI 收集的資訊（見圖 2）。 Mindmaster 因其協作功能而被選中，特別允許多個學生實時同時編輯和視覺化概念圖。 它的侷限性包括依賴穩定的網際網路接入和不熟悉數字地圖工具的學生的短學習曲線。 學生們被引導檢查來自GAI的資訊，並確定資訊背後的概念之間的關係，例如「日落工業的特徵」、「勞動保護」和「環境可持續性」。 然後，他們透過開發概念圖來視覺化這些關係。 構建概念圖的過程不僅是知識的整合，也是對學生理解深度的考驗。 這不僅有助於他們自己的理解和記憶，而且促進了小組成員之間的交流和討論。 因此，構建概念圖進一步促進了學生的溝通與協作，確保每個成員積極參與知識構建。
translation.plainZh: 「知識組織」階段涉及使用 MindMaster 組織 GAI 收集的資訊的協作概念圖建立。 Mindmaster 的實時編輯功能促進了團隊合作，儘管它需要穩定的網際網路和一些數字素養。 學生確定了「日落行業特徵」、「勞動保護」和「環境可持續性」等概念之間的關係，以在概念圖中視覺化它們。 這一過程加深了理解、幫助理解和記憶，並促進了群體內的溝通和積極參與。

segments.section: 3.2. Concept mapping-enhanced GAI-supported collaborative learning (CM-GAI-CL) model
segments.sourceText: In the “Collaborative Verification” stage, students shared and discussed the information and perspectives they obtained from GAI within their group. They engaged in collaborative learning through the constructed concept map to verify the accuracy of concepts and make revisions accordingly (see Fig. 3). This stage focused on verifying information and reflection content in the group learning. The students were encouraged to add real-life examples (e.g., traditional retail vs. e-commerce, print publishers vs. digital media publishers), strategies to prevent sunset industries from disappearing (e.g., digital transformation, improving product or service innovation and repositioning the market), and information about their impact on the economy (e.g., employment impact, slow economic growth and supply chain impact) to their concept maps. This content comprised the learning outcomes inspired by students’ interactions with GAI and discussions with classmates. This process aligned with Vygotsky’s (1986) social constructivism, which emphasizes the promotion of knowledge internalization and construction through social interaction and collaborative learning. Students used MindMaster to display and refine their concept maps, documenting the outcomes and improvement suggestions from group discussions. Meanwhile, GAI addressed students’ advanced questions to help them add information. In addition, students continued to revise and refine their concept maps through group “collaboration,” “reflection,” and “validation.” Such processes helped the students optimize their learning outcomes by further deepening their understanding and confirming the accuracy of the information.

segments.sourceText: This study investigated the impact of the CM-GAI-CL mode on students’ learning achievement in ESD, collective efficacy, critical thinking tendencies, and problem-solving skills. The results indicated that the experimental group outperformed control groups 1 and 2 across all aspects. The research questions are discussed and conclusions presented as follows. Overall, these findings provide empirical support for the cognitive–motivational pathway proposed in this study. Consistent with Social Cognitive Theory (Bandura, 1986, 2000), the findings indicate that structured cognitive scaffolding and collaborative interaction strengthened learners’ collective efficacy, thereby facilitating strategic engagement in complex tasks. This engagement, in turn, supported the development of higher-order thinking processes, including critical thinking and problem solving, ultimately contributing to improved learning achievement and more positive learning experiences.

translation.faithfulZh: 本研究調查了 CM-GAI-CL 模式對 ESD、集體功效、批判性思維趨勢和解決問題技能的學生學習成績的影響。 結果表明，實驗組在各個方面都優於對照組 1 和 2。 討論了研究問題，並給出瞭如下結論。 總體而言，這些發現為本研究中提出的認知動機途徑提供了實證支援。 與社會認知理論（Bandura, 1986, 2000）一致，研究結果表明，結構化的認知支架和協作互動增強了學習者的集體效能，從而促進了複雜任務的戰略參與。 反過來，這種參與支援了高階思維過程的發展，包括批判性思維和解決問題，最終有助於提高學習成績和更積極的學習體驗。

segments.sourceText: Regarding the first research question, the results indicated that the CM-GAI-CL mode had a significant impact on students’ learning achievement. In this collaborative learning mode, GAI served as a personalized learning guide, while concept mapping was utilized as a strategy to help students organize the information or suggestions provided by GAI. The experimental results suggest that GAI alone might not significantly enhance learning achievement, which could be due to the metacognitive laziness induced by using GAI as indicated by some researchers (Fan et al., 2025). This phenomenon manifests when learners overly rely on GAI tools to perform cognitive tasks without critical reflection on the process or the validity, appropriateness, and accuracy of the GAI output. Although no significant difference was found in the “understanding” dimension across the three learning modes, the qualitative patterns and learning behaviors observed in the experimental group suggest that concept mapping may facilitate the process of organizing and interpreting the information provided by GAI. This aligns with Chang et al. (2022) and Lin et al. (2023), who indicated that concept mapping can support learners in grasping the overall structure of complex knowledge, even when such effects might not immediately reveal statistically significant performance differences. Finally, ethical considerations remain salient in AI-assisted learning. In particular, AI bias, misinformation, and student data privacy may shape learners’ experiences and outcomes, underscoring the need for instructional guidance, monitoring, and explicit training in verification practices during AI-supported activities (Barzilai et al., 2025). For example, even when concept mapping is used to help learners structure and integrate GAI-generated ideas, students’ understanding may still be constrained if the content being organized is inaccurate or misleading and learners do not consistently apply verification strategies.

translation.faithfulZh: 關於第一個研究問題，結果表明CM-GAI-CL模式對學生的學習成績有顯著影響。 在這種協作學習模式中，GAI 作為個性化學習指南，而概念對映被用作幫助學生組織 GAI 提供的資訊或建議的策略。 實驗結果表明，單獨的 GAI 可能不會顯著提高學習成就，這可能是由於一些研究人員指出的使用 GAI 引起的元認知懶惰（Fan et al.，2025）。 當學習者過度依賴 GAI 工具來執行認知任務時，這種現象就會表現出來，而無需對 GAI 輸出的過程或有效性、適當性和準確性進行批判性反思。 儘管在三種學習模式的「理解」維度上沒有發現顯著差異，但在實驗組中觀察到的定性模式和學習行為表明，概念對映可能有助於組織和解釋 GAI 提供的資訊的過程。 這與 Chang et al. segments.sourceText: Regarding the “remembering” items, the experimental group and control group 2 outperformed control group 1. The experimental group established connections between knowledge and information using graphical and visual concept maps, which significantly enhanced memory retention (Machado & Carvalho, 2020; Shi et al., 2023). As for control group 2, familiarity with the learning mode allowed students to engage with the content more quickly, reducing the time and effort required to adapt to new technologies, thereby positively influencing their retention. While ChatGPT provided rich conversational interactions for control group 1, this mode of interaction might have increased students’ cognitive load, particularly when they needed to process large amounts of information (Dwivedi et al., 2023). The “remembering” items typically required students to recall extensive, specific knowledge quickly and effectively. Excessive reliance on conversations might divert students’ attention, thereby hindering their memory performance. With regard to the “applying and analyzing” items, the experimental group significantly outperformed the other two groups. These items typically required students to apply learned knowledge to new situations or solve real-world problems, and the use of concept mapping helped students better integrate and apply knowledge, thereby enhancing their application skills (Evans & Jeong, 2023; Machado & Carvalho, 2020). The incorporation of ChatGPT also provided richer interaction and immediate feedback, fostering students’ higher-order thinking and problem-solving skills (Chaunce & McKenna, 2023).

translation.faithfulZh: 關於「記憶」專案，實驗組和對照組 2 優於對照組 1。實驗組使用圖形和視覺概念圖建立了知識和資訊之間的聯絡，從而顯著提高了記憶保留率（Machado & Carvalho，2020； Shi et al.，2023）。 至於對照組 2，熟悉學習模式可以讓學生更快地參與內容，減少適應新技術所需的時間和精力，從而對他們的保留產生積極影響。 雖然 ChatGPT 為對照組 1 提供了豐富的對話互動，但這種互動模式可能會增加學生的認知負荷，特別是當他們需要處理大量資訊時（Dwivedi et al.，2023）。 「記住」專案通常要求學生快速有效地回憶廣泛的特定知識。 過度依賴對話可能會轉移學生的注意力，從而阻礙他們的記憶表現。 在「應用和分析」專案方面，實驗組的表現明顯優於其他兩組。 這些專案通常要求學生將所學知識應用於新情況或解決現實問題，使用概念對映有助於學生更好地整合和應用知識，從而提高他們的應用技能（Evans & Jeong, 2023; Machado & Carvalho, 2020）。 ChatGPT 的結合還提供了更豐富的互動和即時回饋，培養了學生的高階思維和解決問題的能力（Chauncce & McKenna, 2023）。

segments.sourceText: In addition, an analysis of the “applying and analyzing” items revealed that 11 students (33%) from the experimental group, six (23%) from control group 1, and four (14%) from control group 2 revised their selection of the sunset industry. These figures demonstrate the level of student engagement and reflection. Notably, the CM-GAI-CL mode not only increased the number of student responses, but also fostered more active participation and deeper thinking in order to understand and analyze issues related to sunset industries. Concept mapping allowed for the visualization and organization of complex information, helping students effectively integrate new and prior knowledge. This promoted a deeper understanding of the knowledge, and enhanced students’ application skills (Evans & Jeong, 2023; Shi et al., 2023). Concept mapping may also have affected performance through reduced cognitive load and improved collaboration quality. As an external representation, a concept map can lower extraneous working-memory demands during complex learning by organizing and stabilizing information, thereby freeing up resources for integration and reasoning (Sweller, 1988). At the group level, the shared map functions as a common reference point that helps coordinate attention, negotiate meaning, and ground discussion, thereby supporting structured interaction and joint problem solving (Cicognani, 2000; Simone et al., 2001). In contrast, while ChatGPT possessed advantages such as generating diverse perspectives and providing rapid responses, its effectiveness was limited without additional supporting tools. Simply relying on ChatGPT for information might not result in significant improvements in students’ learning achievement. When faced with large volumes of information, students might experience information overload and increased cognitive load. Therefore, this study highlights the necessity of integrating GAI with complementary learning strategies and technological tools. Such integration is crucial for realizing the full potential of GAI, promoting deep learning and independent thinking throughout the knowledge construction process.

segments.sourceText: In terms of “achieving a sense of accomplishment,” concept mapping assisted students in establishing clearer knowledge structures during their learning process. When students could link various types of knowledge and key points together, it enhanced their selfefficacy, thereby increasing their sense of accomplishment (Evans & Jeong, 2023; Ma et al., 2023). Although control group 1 also used ChatGPT, students struggled with understanding and applying the learning content, leading to a lower sense of accomplishment. Control group 2, which relied entirely on the conventional collaborative learning mode, also encountered more challenges, making it harder for them to experience a sense of accomplishment. According to Bandura’s (1999) self-efficacy theory, when students experience success in the learning process, their motivation and sense of achievement are enhanced. Therefore, the learning mode adopted by the experimental group was more effective in terms of increasing students’ sense of accomplishment. In addition, the CM-GAI-CL mode helped students organize their knowledge structure by building conceptual maps through repeated ChatGPT question-and-answer sessions, instant solutions, and feedback. This process resulted in a number of small but concrete mastery experiences, which helped students increase their self-efficacy, leading to a sense of accomplishment (Bandura, 1999). In this study, the experimental group students also frequently mentioned feelings such as “being more confident in completing tasks” and “feeling more capable than before” in their interviews, which echoes Evans and Jeong (2023) and Ma et al. (2023), who emphasized that structured learning tools paired with synergistic learning strategies can enhance learners’ self-efficacy and academic achievement. The observed improvements in the experimental group may be explained by several underlying psychological mechanisms. First, increased self-efficacy and collaborative engagement likely enhanced students’ motivation and participation. Concept mapping and GAI facilitated students’ sense of control over their learning, enabling them to organize information, track progress, and gain confidence during collaborative problem-solving tasks. Second, reduced cognitive load and improved metacognitive regulation allowed students to focus on deeper understanding and critical evaluation. By organizing information visually through concept maps and verifying GAI outputs, students could engage in higher-order cognitive processes such as analysis and synthesis. segments.sourceText: Moreover, this study identified three major limitations in the application of GAI in education. First, due to its limited semantic understanding, GAI sometimes failed to fully grasp the context or complex questions, leading to irrelevant or inaccurate responses. Second, this study used ChatGPT (GPT-3.5 version) because most students could not afford to purchase GPT-4.o. Since ChatGPT was primarily used for discussion and consultation during the learning activities, the selected version was adequate to support the intended learning design. However, adopting a more advanced version such as GPT-4.o in future studies may enable more diverse and sophisticated learning designs by offering improved contextual understanding, reasoning capabilities, and personalized support. Third, GAI lacks emotional or human perceptive abilities, preventing it from truly understanding or empathizing with users’ emotions and circumstances. It might also generate responses containing biases or inappropriate content, requiring students to critically evaluate and filter the information. While the teacher guided students in verifying the information provided by GAI, it is important to note that other search engines could also present incorrect information. Hence, cultivating students’ critical thinking and information filtering skills is crucial, not only for using GAI but also for various other information retrieval methods.

translation.faithfulZh: 此外，本研究確定了 GAI 在教育中應用的三個主要限制。 首先，由於其語義理解有限，GAI 有時無法完全掌握上下文或複雜的問題，導致不相關或不準確的回答。 其次，本研究使用 ChatGPT（GPT-3.5 版），因為大多數學生買不起 GPT-4.O。 由於 ChatGPT 主要用於在學習活動期間進行討論和諮詢，因此所選版本足以支援預期的學習設計。 然而，在未來的研究中採用更高階的版本，例如 GPT-4.O，可以透過提供改進的上下文理解、推理能力和個性化支援來實現更多樣化和複雜的學習設計。 第三，GAI 缺乏情感或人類的感知能力，無法真正理解或同情使用者的情緒和環境。 它還可能產生包含偏見或不恰當內容的響應，要求學生批判性地評估和過濾資訊。 在教師指導學生驗證 GAI 提供的資訊的同時，重要的是要注意其他搜尋引擎也可能提供不正確的資訊。 因此，培養學生的批判性思維和資訊過濾技能至關重要，不僅對於使用 GAI，而且對於各種其他資訊檢索方法也是如此。

segments.sourceText: Lastly, we propose the following recommendations to guide future research in exploring the challenges and potential of AI tools in education: 1. It is recommended that future research explore how to integrate GAI with other personalized learning systems or to develop further personalized AI models that can automatically adjust content and teaching methods based on students’ learning situations and performance, thereby enhancing the educational applicability of AI tools. In this context, concept mapping can be incorporated as a visual and diagnostic tool to represent students’ cognitive structures, enabling the AI system to better identify learning gaps and tailor instructional prompts accordingly. 2. Future research should integrate GAI with various teaching modes, using it as a supplementary tool rather than as the primary learning pathway. Educators could combine AI technology with conventional teaching methods to foster collaboration and discussion between teachers and students, thereby balancing the importance of technological applications with interpersonal communication. 3. The convenience of immediate feedback provided by GAI may reduce opportunities for students to engage in independent thinking. If students become accustomed to relying on GAI for answers, they may neglect the underlying logical reasoning and analytical processes, potentially leading to a decline in their cognitive abilities. Therefore, it is recommended that future educators design challenging tasks that require students to reflect, summarize, and critique after using AI. For instance, students could be asked to further explain or expand upon the AI-generated answers, ensuring that they not only understand the results but also grasp the underlying processes and principles. 4. Since GAI’s responses are based on existing data and patterns, it may not be effective in terms of fostering students’ creative thinking, particularly in situations that require divergent thinking or innovative problem solving. Future research could explore how to integrate GAI with creative learning activities, such as designing tasks that ask students to critique or expand on AIgenerated answers, thereby stimulating their creative thinking. Additionally, teachers could use GAI to generate different options or perspectives, prompting students to engage in assessments, make comparisons, and express their creativity. 5. It is also crucial to consider ethical issues, including AI bias, misinformation, and student data privacy. 6. In addition, exploring the role of teacher facilitation, cooperative learning dimensions, and the relationship between affective and metacognitive constructs may further enhance the educational effectiveness of AI-assisted learning.

segments.sourceText: The limitations and recommendations presented in this study not only highlight the technical and social challenges of applying ChatGPT in education, but also provide innovative perspectives on how to more effectively integrate AI into educational systems. In addition, the CM-GAI-CL model developed for this study demonstrated strong theoretical and practical contributions by innovatively combining concept maps and GAI in the ESD curriculum. At the theoretical level, this study breaks through the single application of GAI tools in language learning or writing assistance, and fills the gap in the literature on how AI can support sustainability, systems thinking, and civic responsibility education. At the practical level, the CM-GAI-CL model provides educators with an operational and flexible teaching framework to help students engage in interdisciplinary thinking, critical analysis, and civic engagement when faced with authentic issues. This not only enhances students’ understanding of sustainable development, but also provides a feasible template for future AI-assisted sustainable education curriculum design, which is of far-reaching significance to the development of education technology.

abstract.faithfulZh: 在大量錯誤資訊的時代，學生必須學會評估來源的可信度，以便他們能夠確定科學資訊的可靠性。 我們研究的目的是促進對認知支架如何在學生從事科學探究學習時的源頭評估的發展做出貢獻的理解。 在一項針對 137 名 9 年級學生的準實驗研究中，我們研究了兩種認知支架的加性貢獻：（1）文件繪圖支架，旨在透過促使學習者評估支援與採購過程和標準的認知參與 來源和連結來源和內容； (2) 一個共享的標準支架，旨在透過讓學習者參與制定和討論班級標準列表來促進對源評估標準的元認知理解。 使用文件對映 Scaffold 進行學習增加了使用源可信度標準來評估文件以及議論文中的關鍵來源評估。 新增共享標準 scaffold 導致論文中採購標準和關鍵來源評估的使用量大幅增加。 共享標準支架還減少了對來源不可靠的檔案的選擇，並增加了對採購標準的元認知理解。 腳手架不影響來源引用和具有可靠來源的檔案選擇。 這些結果表明，使用文件對映支架進行學習，鼓勵學生評估來源並跟蹤誰說了什麼，可以在一定程度上改善關鍵來源評估。 然而，讓學生參與制定和討論共享標準可以促進元認知增長，從而支援關鍵來源評估的更大改進。

abstract.faithfulZh: 英語已被公認為全球範圍內的交流方式。 然而，由於缺乏現實的英語實踐環境，EFL（英語作為外語）的學生通常幾乎沒有機會用英語與人交流，更不用說從他人那裡獲得回饋以進行反思。 在這項研究中，開發了一個基於球形影片的虛擬現實 (SVVR) 環境，將學生置於真實的英語語境中； 此外，採用同行評估 (PA) 策略來指導學生對同行的口語表現發表評論並對自己的表現進行反思。 為了評估所提出方法的有效性，在高中英語課程中進行了一個實驗。 實驗結果揭示了基於同伴評估的 SVVR 方法在學習者的英語口語、學習動機和批判性思維能力方面與非基於同伴評估的 SVVR 方法以及減少英語學習焦慮的積極影響。 此外，發現學生的評分與教師的評分在統計學上相關。 本研究透過將同行評論分為四種型別進一步分析了同行評論的型別：表揚、批評、意見和無關。 發現讚美回饋有助於學生的英語表現，而批評回饋在這種情況下可能是不利的。 此外，不相關的回饋與 PA 早期階段的學生表現沒有顯著相關性，但在後期具有顯著的負相關性。

abstract.faithfulZh: 概念圖是一組相關概念的視覺化，它們的關係由有向箭頭標識，可以被視為在學習者的長期記憶中編碼的模式的外部化。 概念圖已成為各種教育環境中的流行學習工具。 然而，現有的研究尚未完全探索概念對映作為學習工具的有效性，也沒有分析其作為數學評估工具的效用。 本研究報告了大學數學課程中新評估、概念對映的實施和評估（n = 219）。 我們研究了概念對映效能與兩個主要結果變數之間的關係：學業成就和評估自我效能感（一種包括理解和執行以及情緒調節的兩因素測量）。 分層多元迴歸表明，概念對映效能解釋了在考慮其他常規課程作業評估後，在最終考試分數和評估自我效能感的情緒調節因素方面存在統計學上顯著的差異。 最終考試中解釋的差異表明，用作評估工具的概念對映可以檢測和評估傳統評估無法識別的學習者的不同能力。 因此，概念對映評估概念理解的潛力值得進一步研究。 此外，與情緒調節效能度量的關聯表明，作為一種學習活動的概念對映涉及比典型作業更積極地面對挑戰的能力。 這可能表明在積極參與意義建構和概念對映所引發的關係推理型別的同時，更加毅力和努力學習。
