abstract.originalText: Abstract With the continuous development of technological and educational innovation, learners nowadays can obtain a variety of supports from agents such as teachers, peers, education
abstract.summaryZh: 摘要 隨著科技創新的不斷髮展，現在的學習者可以從教師、同齡人、教育技術和近期的ChatGPT等生成人工智慧中獲得各種支援。 為了解決這一差距，我們進行了一項隨機實驗研究，並比較了學習者的動機、自我調節的學習過程和在不同群體支援的不同群體（即 ChatGPT）（也稱為 AI 組）、與人類專家聊天、寫作分析方面的學習表現 工具，沒有額外的工具。 結果表明：（1）接受不同學習支援的學習者在任務後內在動機方面沒有差異； (2) 組間自我調節學習過程的頻率和序列存在顯著差異； (3) ChatGPT 組在論文分數提高方面表現優於，但他們的知識增益和轉移沒有顯著差異。
abstract.faithfulZh: 隨著技術和教育創新的不斷髮展，現在的學習者可以從教師、同齡人、教育技術和最近的聊天等人工智慧中獲得各種支援。 特別是，人們對人工智慧協作和學習中的混合智慧的學術興趣激增。 混合智慧的概念仍處於新生階段，學習者如何從與人工智慧、人類專家和智慧學習系統等各種智慧體的共生關係中受益，仍然未知。 混合智慧的新興概念還缺乏對基於強大實證研究的混合人工智慧學習機制和後果的深刻見解和理解。 為了解決這一差距，我們進行了一項隨機實驗研究，並比較了學習者的動機、自我調節的學習過程和在不同群體支援的不同群體（即 ChatGPT）（也稱為 AI 組）、與人類專家聊天、寫作分析方面的學習表現 工具，沒有額外的工具。 共招募了 117 名大學生，並收集和分析了他們的多渠道學習、表現和動機資料。 結果表明：（1）接受不同學習支援的學習者在任務後內在動機方面沒有差異； (2) 組間自我調節學習過程的頻率和序列存在顯著差異； (3) ChatGPT 組在論文分數提高方面表現優於，但他們的知識增益和轉移沒有顯著差異。 我們的研究發現，在沒有動機差異的情況下，具有不同支援的學習者仍然表現出不同的自我調節學習過程，最終導致表現差異化。 特別值得注意的是，ChatGPT 等人工智慧技術可能會促進學習者對技術的依賴，並可能引發“元認知懶惰”。 總之，理解和利用不同學習者在學習中各自的優勢和劣勢在未來的混合智慧領域中至關重要。 從業者注意到關於這個主題的混合智慧結合了人類和機器智慧，旨在增強人類能力而不是取代它們，為更有效的終身學習和協作創造機會。 生成性人工智慧（如 ChatGPT）透過提供即時回饋、克服語言障礙和促進個性化教育體驗，在增強學習方面表現出潛力。 人工智慧在教育環境中的有效性各不相同，一些研究強調了它在提高學習成績和動機方面的好處，而另一些研究則指出其完全取代人類教師的能力存在侷限性。 本文補充說，我們在實驗室環境中進行了一項隨機實驗研究，並比較了學習者的動機、自我調節的學習過程和不同代理組（AI、人類專家和清單工具）的學習表現。 我們發現，ChatGPT等人工智慧技術可能會促進學習者對技術的依賴，並可能引發元認知“懶惰”，這可能會阻礙他們自我調節和深入參與學習的能力。 我們還發現 ChatGPT 可以顯著提高短期任務績效，但可能不會提高內在動機和知識的獲取和轉移。 對實踐和/或政策的影響 在學習中使用人工智慧時，學習者應專注於加深對知識的理解，並積極參與評估、監控和定位等元認知過程，而不是盲目地遵循 ChatGPT 的回饋以有效地完成任務。 在教學中使用人工智慧時，教師應考慮哪些任務適合學習者在 AI 的幫助下完成，注意激發學習者的內在動機，並開發腳手架以幫助學習者積極學習。 研究人員應該在未來設計多工和跨背景研究，以加深我們對學習者如何道德和有效地學習、監管、協作和與人工智慧發展的理解。

abstract.faithfulZh: 人工智慧 (AI) 引起了跨學科和行業的廣泛關注（Hyder 等人，Citation2019）。 人工智慧被定義為“一個系統能夠正確解釋外部資料、從這些資料中學習並透過靈活的適應來利用這些學習來實現特定的目標和任務的能力”（Kaplan & Haenlein, Citation2019, p. 15）。 人工智慧經歷了幾個發展階段和人工智慧的冬天。 在前兩個十年（即 1950 年代和 1960 年代）中，AI 展示了成功，其中包括一般問題求解器（Newell 等人，Citation1959）和 Eliza（Weizenbaum，Citation1966）等專案。 然而，處理能力的限制和人工智慧支出的減少使其發展陷入停滯。 近年來，AI在2015年推出了AlphaGo和2022年的ChatGPT後捲土重來。繼2022年末OpenAI的名為“聊天生成預訓練變壓器”或ChatGPT的應用程式釋出後，AI 引起了全世界的關注。

abstract.originalText: In traditional instruction, teachers generally deliver the content of textbooks to students via lectures, making teaching activities lack vibrancy. Moreover, in such a one-to-many teaching
abstract.faithfulZh: 在傳統教學中，教師一般透過講座將教科書的內容傳達給學生，使得教學活動缺乏活力。 此外，在這樣的一對多教學模式下，教師通常無法檢查個別學生的學習狀態或提供即時回饋以解決他們的學習問題。 聊天機器人提供瞭解決此問題的機會。 然而，傳統的聊天機器人通常充當資訊提供者（即，透過在對話中匹配關鍵字來提供相關資訊），而不是作為決策顧問（即，使用具有決策機制的知識庫來幫助使用者解決問題）。 因此，本研究提出了一個基於專家決策的聊天機器人，以促進個體學生在學習過程中構建知識。 進行了一個準實驗，以比較在地理課程活動中使用基於專家決策的聊天機器人（EDM-Chatbot）和傳統聊天機器人（C-Chatbot）在學生的表現和看法方面的差異。 一班 35 名學生是實驗組，使用 EDM-Chatbot。 其他 35 名學生是使用 C-Chatbot 的對照組。 研究結果表明，EDM-Chatbot 結合專家決策知識，顯著提高了學生的學習成績和學習樂趣，並減少了他們的學習焦慮，顯示了所提出的方法的價值。

abstract.summaryZh: 數字技術在學生的創造性思維培養中起著獨特的作用，透過有效和原創的解決方案幫助他們解決結構不佳的問題。 配對樣本 t 檢驗用於分析學生創造性思維的前後測驗，以驗證所有四種協作學習模式是否可以改善學生的創造性思維。 採用單向方差分析分析四組創造性思維的後測結果，以確定四組學生的創造性思維差異。 具體來說，教師應該讓學生以自由的方式參與集體協作學習，以培養他們的靈活性。
abstract.faithfulZh: 數字技術在學生的創造性思維培養中起著獨特的作用，透過有效和原創的解決方案幫助他們解決結構不佳的問題。 本研究在數字技術支援的人工智慧 (AI) 課程中應用了協作學習，旨在探索協作學習對四年級學生創造性思維的影響。 根據教師是否分配了領導角色並在小組中建立了最終共識，設計了四種協作學習模式以進行比較，以確定哪種模式更有效地促進學生的創造性思維。 共有37名四年級學生參加了本次研究，分為四組，每組採用四種協作學習模式中的一種。 託倫斯創造性思維測試（ttct-figure）用於測試四組學生的創作前和創作後思維。 配對樣本 t 檢驗用於分析學生創造性思維的前後測驗，以驗證所有四種協作學習模式是否可以改善學生的創造性思維。 採用單向方差分析分析四組創造性思維的後測結果，以確定四組學生的創造性思維差異。 結果表明，G1、G3 和 G4 使用的協作學習模式對提高學生的創造性思維有效，但 G2 模式並非如此。 此外，在這四種協作學習模式中，透過 AI 課程培養學生創造性思維的培養存在顯著差異。 G4 的學生具有分配的領導角色和共識，在創造性思維方面表現出最大的進步。 特別是，如果沒有指定的領導角色和共識建立，學生的創造性思維靈活性將在更大程度上得到提高。 教師可以調整本研究的結果，以便在協作學習過程中有意識地培訓團隊領導者，並引導他們達成共識，以實現在數字技術支援的課程中培養創造性思維的目標。 具體來說，教師應該讓學生以自由的方式參與集體協作學習，以培養他們的靈活性。

abstract.faithfulZh: 閱讀理解是學習的基本技能，透過廣泛的閱讀、文字討論和分析以及寫作來促進。 隨著移動技術的普及，基於人工智慧（AI）的聊天機器人結合了語音識別和語義理解，是一種潛在的語言學習工具，可以透過提供個性化的實時回饋來克服學生在傳統教學中遇到的學習困難。 然而，一些學生無法透過純文字閱讀來組織學習內容，導致學習效果不佳。 圖形組織被視為提高學生記憶力和理解力的有用策略。 該研究採用準實驗設計來研究智慧聊天機器人結合圖形摘要策略、語音識別和語義理解對學生的閱讀表現、學習經驗以及批判性和反思性思考的傾向的影響。 受試者為 107 名 10 年級學生，隨機分為四組，使用基於圖形彙總的 AI 聊天機器人、基於文字摘要的 AI 聊天機器人、基於圖形摘要的學習和基於文字摘要的學習。 結果發現，基於 AI 的聊天機器人和圖形摘要策略都透過提高學生的學習成績而使學生受益； 此外，基於 AI 的聊天機器人和圖形摘要策略之間的顯著互動進一步表明了兩者結合的有效性。 在內在動機、自我效能、批判性思維和認知負荷方面，基於人工智慧的聊天機器人比傳統教學更有利於學生； 此外，圖形摘要策略比文字摘要更有利於學生。 訪談結果進一步表明，結合圖形摘要策略和基於AI的聊天機器人使學生能夠更全面地瞭解學習內容。

abstract.faithfulZh: 合作學習的廣泛和越來越多的使用是社會和教育心理學的偉大成功案例之一。 它的成功很大程度上取決於理論、研究和實踐之間的關係。 社會相互依賴理論為建立合作學習奠定了基礎。 在過去的 11 年中，已經進行了 1,200 多項關於合作、競爭和個人主義努力的研究。 這些研究的結果驗證、修改、完善和擴充套件了該理論。 根據該理論，教師在使用正式和非正式合作學習和合作基礎小組中的作用的程式已經得到了實施。 這些程式被全世界的教育工作者廣泛使用。 這些應用導致了理論的修訂和新研究的產生。

abstract.originalText: Large language models represent a significant advancement in the field of AI. The underlying technology is key to further innovations and, despite critical views and
abstract.faithfulZh: 大型語言模型代表了人工智慧領域的重大進步。 底層技術是進一步創新的關鍵，儘管社羣和地區內有批判性觀點甚至禁令，但大型語言模型仍將繼續存在。 本文從學生和教師的角度介紹了大型語言模型教育應用的潛在好處和挑戰。 我們簡要討論了大型語言模型的當前狀態及其應用。 然後，我們強調如何使用這些模型來建立教育內容、提高學生的參與度和互動以及個性化的學習體驗。 關於挑戰，我們認為教育中的大型語言模型要求教師和學習者開發出一系列能力和識字能力，以瞭解技術以及它們的侷限性和意外脆弱性。 此外，還需要一個明確的教育系統戰略和一個明確的教學方法，重點關注批判性思維和事實核查策略，以整合和充分利用學習環境和教學課程中的大型語言模型。 其他挑戰，例如產出的潛在偏差、對持續的人工監督的需求以及誤用的可能性並不是將人工智慧應用於教育中所獨有的。 但我們相信，如果處理得明智，這些挑戰可以在教育場景中提供見解和機會，讓學生在早期瞭解潛在的社會偏見、關鍵性和人工智慧應用的風險。 最後，我們提出瞭如何應對這些挑戰並確保在教育中以負責任和道德的方式使用此類模型的建議。

abstract.originalText: Why do people create extra representations to help them make sense of situations, diagrams, illustrations, instructions and problems? The obvious explanation—external representations save internal memory
abstract.faithfulZh: 為什麼人們會建立額外的表示來幫助他們理解情況、圖表、插圖、說明和問題？ 明顯的解釋——外部表示節省了內部記憶和計算——只是故事的一部分。 我討論了外部表徵增強認知能力的七種方式：它們改變了推理格局的成本結構； 它們提供了一種可以作為可共享的思想物件的結構； 它們建立持久的參照物； 它們促進了重新表徵； 它們通常比心理表徵更自然地表示結構； 它們有助於計算更明確的資訊編碼； 它們能夠構建任意複雜的結構； 他們降低了控制思想的成本——它們有助於協調思想。 這些功能共同允許人們用外部表示比沒有外部表示更有力地思考。 它們讓我們認為以前不可思議的。

abstract.originalText: Any teacher or parent can tell you that many students are bored in school. But many of them tend to assume that boredom is not
abstract.faithfulZh: 任何老師或家長都可以告訴您，許多學生在學校感到無聊。 但他們中的許多人傾向於認為無聊不是最好的學生的問題，如果學生更加努力或學習得更好，他們就不會感到無聊。 在 1980 年代和 1990 年代，教育研究人員越來越多地意識到，當學生感到無聊和不投入時，他們學習的可能性較小（Blumenfeld 等，1991）。 對學生經驗的研究發現，幾乎所有學生在學校都很無聊，即使是那些在標準化考試中得分高的學生（Csikszentmihalyi, Rathunde, & Whalen, 1993）。 到 1990 年左右，教育研究人員很明顯問題不在於學生的錯。 學校的結構有點問題。 如果我們能找到一種方法讓學生參與他們的學習，重組課堂，讓學生有學習的動力，那將是一個巨大的變化。 同樣到 1990 年左右，對大學生的新評估表明，他們在高中獲得的知識仍然處於膚淺的水平。 即使是得分最高的學生，即頂尖大學的學生，也往往沒有對材料有更深入的概念理解——無論是在科學、文學還是數學方面（Gardner，1991）。 教育工作者今天仍然面臨這些關鍵問題。

abstract.faithfulZh: 生成式人工智慧 (GAI) 的出現為學生提供了體驗與真實人類相似的學習互動的機會。 這項技術使學生能夠用自然語言與人工智慧進行交流； GAI 還可以生成更符合學生需求的內容。 值得注意的是，在移動學習的背景下，學生將有更多的機會與 GAI 互動。 因此，探索 GAI 在移動學習環境中的作用以及與學習策略的可能結合是一個重要的話題。 在這篇論文中，我們從學術研究和教育目標的角度討論這個話題。 我們還討論了學生在各種教育目標中角色的轉變。 此外，本研究探討了潛在的研究和教育問題，包括整合學習策略、討論學生學習表現、與其他軟體和硬體整合、學生與 GAI 的互動以及 GAI 學習權問題。

abstract.originalText: In recent months, Artificial Intelligence (AI) has had, and will continue to have, a dramatic impact on Higher Education (HE). A study conducted by researchers
abstract.faithfulZh: 最近幾個月，人工智慧（AI）已經並將繼續對高等教育（HE）產生巨大影響。 澳大利亞一所領先大學的研究人員進行的一項研究調查了他們的 30 名教職員工，主要來自他們的教學學院，並採訪了其中的 8 人，瞭解了 AI 對 HE 的影響。 使用歸納主題分析程式分析資料，揭示了 HE 中缺乏圍繞 AI 的任何同質情緒，並且對有關近期技術發展的最佳實踐的模糊性非常模糊。 結果表明，人們對與學術誠信相關的概念存在擔憂，但是，這些擔憂可能被誇大了。 幾乎一半的參與者表示他們在教學角色中使用人工智慧，最常見的設計變化是對評估的修改。 不到四分之一的工作人員同意該大學已經為他們配備了足夠的人工智慧裝置，超過四分之三的人表示他們希望得到支援。 他們一致認為技術會改進。 考慮到大學透過為行業做好準備來為學生服務的義務，HE 行業必須隨時瞭解 AI 的發展並致力於就 AI 的最佳實踐進行持續的研究和討論，這一點非常重要。 然而，關於人工智慧和未來發展的任何事情都將非常難以預測。

abstract.faithfulZh: EFL（英語作為外語）學生學習英語的最大挑戰之一是缺乏實踐環境。 儘管語言研究人員試圖進行翻轉課堂以增加課堂上的練習時間，但 EFL 學生通常難以在課堂上與同齡人和老師互動。 人工智慧（AI）的進步為解決這個問題提供了機會。 藉助人工智慧技術，計算機系統，特別是以人工智慧聊天機器人的形式，能夠識別使用者陳述的含義並做出相應的回應。 在研究設計中，基於 AI 的聊天機器人被用於課堂和課外活動，以促進學生在大學翻轉英語課堂的學習過程中的口語表現和互動。 實驗結果表明，思維導圖的 AI 聊天機器人方法 (MM-AI) 比傳統的 AI 聊天機器人 (C-AI) 更能促進學生的英語口語表現。 此外，MM-AI 還促進了學生的學習表現，並比 C-AI 更能組織機器人與人類之間的互動。 對於打算在語言學習中進行人工智慧支援的翻轉課堂的語言教育者和研究人員來說，這些發現可能是一個有價值的參考。

abstract.originalText: BACKGROUND Didactic lectures and exam-oriented learning can lead to students becoming passive learners who rely on rote memory. This learning style negatively impacts their ability
abstract.faithfulZh: 背景教學講座和以考試為導向的學習可以使學生成為依賴死記硬背的被動學習者。 這種學習方式對他們培養核心護理價值觀和批判性思維的能力產生了負面影響。 目的 本研究旨在調查概念對映教學策略對本科生護理學生將理論生物科學知識整合到護理實踐中的能力以及他們的批判性思維和團隊合作技能的影響。 方法採用定性研究設計。 基於涉及 24 個與醫療和外科護理相關的模擬病例的概念對映策略開發了題為“成人護理病例評估和分析”的課程。 參與者是臺灣大學兩年制本科護理課程的學生。 資料是從 2020 年 9 月到 2021 年 2 月收集的。定性資料是從對 20 名學生的半結構化面對面訪談和 100 份關於學生學習旅程的反思性報告中收集的。 使用定性內容分析分析資料。 結果 確定了兩個主要主題：（1）學習方式和思維的變化和（2）學習的回報。 參與者報告說，他們的學習方式已經從依賴死記硬背學習到影象記憶，以及他們的思維過程從線性（因果）到不同層次的多方面思維。 教學和學習策略有助於提高能力感和心理安全感，從而帶來學習成就和信心。 結論 使用概念對映策略和模擬案例增強了學生的學習能力，使學生能夠整合理論知識並提高他們的思維能力。 教學和學習策略幫助參與者瞭解心理安全並增強了他們的學習信心。

abstract.originalText: Computational thinking (CT) is an imperative competency in the 21st century. Mindtools can assist students in understanding concepts and decomposing tasks during CT development through
abstract.faithfulZh: 運算思維 (CT) 是 21 世紀的一種必要能力。 MindTools 可以透過程式設計幫助學生理解 CT 開發過程中的概念和分解任務。 然而，由於在沒有適當指導的情況下使用 MindTools 時感到困惑，學生可能會在複雜的 CT 問題解決任務中遇到挑戰。 研究證據表明，透過調節認知活動，在複雜的 CT 問題解決中進行反思的潛力。 因此，本研究設計了一種反思引導的視覺化 MindTool 策略來應對 CT 發展挑戰。 透過招募 97 名初中學生來檢查所提出的策略對 CT 發展的影響並探索學生的行為模式，進行了準實驗和滯後順序分析。 結果表明，該方法提高了學生的 CT 表現、CT 性格、元認知意識和學習動機。 與對照組中的學生相比，學習所提出的策略的學生表現出更多的關鍵行為，即促進 CT 問題解決（例如，概括知識、重新設計演算法方案和評估他們提出的方案的可行性），揭示了 CT 發展的基本過程 並啟發教師在培養 CT 時指導學生進行此類學習過程。

abstract.faithfulZh: ChatGPT 透過利用深度學習模型生成類似人類的內容，正在徹底改變高等教育領域。 然而，它與學術環境的整合引起了人們對學術誠信、抄襲檢測以及對批判性思維技能的潛在影響的擔憂。 本文介紹了一項研究，該研究採用民族誌方法來理解 ChatGPT 對高等教育所面臨的挑戰和機遇的看法。 該研究探討了 ChatGPT 的潛在好處和侷限性，以及解決已確定挑戰的緩解策略。 調查結果強調迫切需要明確的政策、指導方針和框架，以負責任地將 ChatGPT 整合到高等教育中。 它還強調了實證研究以瞭解使用者體驗和看法的必要性。 這些發現提供了一些見解，可以指導未來的研究工作，以瞭解 ChatGPT 和類似人工智慧 (AI) 系統在高等教育中的影響。 該研究最後強調了事物民族誌作為一種與智慧人工智慧系統互動的創新方法的重要性，並呼籲進一步研究探索將生成人工智慧用於教育目的的最佳實踐和策略。

abstract.originalText: ChatGPT is the world’s most advanced chatbot thus far. Unlike other chatbots, it can create impressive prose within seconds, and it has created much hype
abstract.faithfulZh: ChatGPT 是迄今為止世界上最先進的聊天機器人。 與其他聊天機器人不同，它可以在幾秒鐘內創造出令人印象深刻的散文，並且在高等教育和許多其他問題的學生評估方面創造了許多炒作和世界末日預測。 ChatGPT 是一種最先進的語言模型（OpenAI 的生成預訓練變換器 (GPT) 語言模型的一種變體），旨在生成與人類所寫的文字無法區分的文字。 它可以以看似自然和直觀的方式與使用者進行對話。 在本文中，我們簡要地講述了 ChatGPT 背後的組織 OpenAI 的故事。 我們強調從非營利組織到商業商業模式的根本性變化。 在我們的方法方面，我們進行了廣泛的文獻回顧並試驗了這種人工智慧 (AI) 軟體。 我們的文獻綜述表明，我們的評論是第一個探索 ChatGPT 及其與高等教育相關性（尤其是評估、學習和教學）的同行評審的學術期刊文章之一。 在描述了 ChatGPT 的功能及其優勢和侷限性的總結之後，我們專注於該技術對高等教育的影響，並在 ChatGPT 等人工智慧聊天機器人的背景下討論高等教育中的學習、教學和評估的未來是什麼。 我們將 ChatGPT 定位在當前教育 (AIED) 研究中的人工智慧 (AIED) 研究的背景下，討論面向學生、面向教師和麵向系統的應用程式，並分析機會和威脅。 我們在本文中為學生、教師和高等教育機構提供了建議。 他們中的許多人專注於評估。

abstract.faithfulZh: 本文從班杜拉的社會認知理論的角度討論動機。 動機是指激發和維持目標導向活動的過程。 動機過程是個人/內部影響，會導致選擇、努力、堅持、成就和環境監管等結果。 從早期建模研究到涉及代理的當前概念，動機一直是社會認知理論的一個突出特徵。 討論了互惠互動的概念框架，之後對行為、環境和個人對動機的影響進行了總結。 關鍵的內部動機過程是進度、自我效能、社會比較、價值觀、結果期望、歸因和自我調節的目標和自我評估。 該理論面臨的關鍵問題包括多樣性和文化、方法論和干預措施的長期影響。 本文最後為未來對背景、概念清晰度和技術的研究提出了額外的建議。

abstract.faithfulZh: 思維導圖是教學中使用的視覺化工具，可以被學習者應用來產生想法、做筆記、組織思維和發展概念。 使用思維導圖的教學正變得越來越常用於教育中。 然而，關於基於思維導圖的教學對學生學習成果的有效性，研究產生了不一致的結果。 使用 21 項研究的薈萃分析，本研究調查了基於思維導圖的指令對學生學習成果的整體有效性，與傳統教學相比。 與傳統教學相比，基於思維導圖的教學對學生的認知學習成果有更大的積極影響。 對調節變數的分析表明，主題和教育水平是基於思維導圖的教學有效性的重要因素。 與高年級學生相比，低年級學生更容易受到基於思維導圖的教學的影響，而基於思維導圖的教學可以幫助學生提高所有學科的認知學習成果，特別是在科學、技術、工程和數學學科中。

abstract.originalText: Concept mapping-based language learning (CMLL) has attracted increasing attention from the research community. Many studies have investigated non-technology-based CMLL (NTCMLL) and technology-based CMLL (TCMLL); however,
abstract.faithfulZh: 基於概念對映的語言學習 (CMLL) 引起了研究界越來越多的關注。 許多研究調查了基於非技術的 CMLL (NTCMLL) 和基於技術的 CMLL (TCMLL)； 然而，文獻沒有顯示將兩者進行比較，這是必要的，因為這可以確定技術和非基於技術的 CM 活動在協助語言學習方面的差異化適用性。 因此，本研究回顧了 26 項比較 NTCMLL 與 TCMLL 關於出版性質、理論框架、目標語言、學習成果、CM 活動和用於概念對映技術的研究。 結果表明，(a) NTCMLL 和 TCMLL 研究自 2016 年以來變得流行； (b) 有意義的學習是最常見的理論支援； (c) 英語是最常被調查的語言； (d) 討論最多的學習成果是語言習得和心理狀態； (e) 經常使用個人概念對映； (f) 現成工具的應用比研究人員的自開發系統更多。 我們還確定了 NTCMLL 和 TCMLL 研究之間的異同，同時討論了對它們未來設計的重要影響。

abstract.faithfulZh: 線上資訊問題解決 (OIPS) 對於 21 世紀的資訊素養至關重要，這通常需要資訊選擇能力。 然而，學生通常在從複雜的網路資源中區分資訊方面遇到問題。 這項研究利用眼動追蹤技術，旨在檢查網路搜尋環境中學習者視覺搜尋模式、資訊焦慮和 OIPS 任務表現之間的關係。 在這項研究中，46 名大學生自願參加了一項解決滑坡問題的網路搜尋任務。 學生的視覺行為在任務期間由眼動追蹤者記錄，任務後立即自我報告資訊焦慮。 還記錄和評分反應時間和任務表現。 進行了 Pearson 的相關性分析、多元迴歸分析、聚類分析和滯後順序分析 (LSA)。 結果表明，學習者的眼動追蹤測量、資訊焦慮和任務表現在 OIPS 中顯著相關。 學生對不相關的網路資訊的視覺注意力可以顯著而積極地預測他們的資訊焦慮，但對他們的任務表現進行負面預測。 此外，基於眼動追蹤測量和反應時間，確定了三種視覺搜尋模式：混亂、思維緩慢和快速思考。 LSA 結果進一步表明，不同的群體使用不同的資訊選擇和注意力控制策略，尤其是在區分 Web 資訊的相關性時。 本研究在 OIPS 環境中連線眼動追蹤測量、資訊焦慮和任務表現之間的關聯。 建議未來的研究使用聚類分析和 LSA 分析眼動追蹤資料，以在視覺搜尋或資訊處理模式方面分析線上學習者的特徵。

abstract.originalText: Research on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in language education becomes more popular. This revolutionary technology is regarded as a promising tool to assist language learning environments
abstract.faithfulZh: 語言教育中對人工智慧（AI）的研究變得越來越流行。 這種革命性的技術被認為是一種有前途的工具，可以透過支援自動回饋、智慧輔導和個性化來幫助語言學習環境。 在設計智慧計算機輔助語言學習 (ICALL) 環境的同時，教育工作者遵循了教學第一原則 (FPI)，包括以問題為中心、啟用、演示、應用和整合。 這些教學設計原則是可以採用的，因為它們為學習活動提供瞭解決問題的重點，滿足了學習者與過程相關性的需求。 儘管在 ICALL 環境中使用了不同的教學設計原則，並報告了它們對學生學習結果的相應影響，但很少有研究人員以系統的評價方法檢查相關研究，而更少的學者探索了所採用的教學設計原則的挑戰。 為了填補這一空白，我們對來自 Web of Science、Eric、Scopus 和 ProQuest 社會科學資料庫的 83 篇相關論文進行了系統評價。 我們旨在研究 FPI 在 ICALL 中的應用，並提出兩個研究問題：（1）ICALL 環境如何從 FPI 的角度促進學習？ (2) ICALL 環境面臨哪些挑戰？ 內容分析和主題分析用於分析收集的論文。 我們的研究結果揭示了自動回饋的演示和應用原則的應用、智慧輔導的啟用原理以及以問題為中心的個性化整合原則。 同時，我們討論了這些研究的挑戰，並提出了教學設計見解和對教育實踐的經驗建議。

abstract.originalText: Visual learning analytics (VLA) is becoming increasingly adopted in educational technologies and learning analytics dashboards to convey critical insights to students and educators. Yet many
abstract.faithfulZh: 視覺學習分析 (VLA) 越來越多地被教育技術和學習分析儀表板採用，以向學生和教育工作者傳達重要的見解。 然而，由於資料視覺化素養有限，許多學生在理解複雜 VLA 方面遇到了困難。 雖然像資料講故事這樣的傳統腳手架方法已顯示出在提高學生對 VLA 的理解方面的有效性，但這些方法仍然難以擴充套件和適應個人學習需求。 生成式 AI (Genai) 技術，尤其是對話代理，透過提供個性化和動態支援來增強學生對 VLA 的理解，提供了潛在的解決方案。 這項對照實驗室研究調查了 Genai 代理在提高學生對 VLA 的理解方面的有效性，特別是與腳手架技術相結合時。 對 117 名高等教育學生進行了一項隨機對照試驗，以比較兩種型別的 Genai 代理的影響：被動代理人（響應學生查詢的被動代理人）和利用腳手架問題的主動代理與 VLA 理解任務中的獨立腳手架進行比較。 結果表明，在干預期間和干預之後，被動劑對獨立腳手架產生了可比的改進。 值得注意的是，與被動代理和獨立腳手架相比，主動 Genai 代理顯著增強了學生的 VLA 理解能力，這些好處在干預之外持續存在。 這些發現表明，將 Genai 代理與腳手架結合起來可以對學生的理解能力產生持久的積極影響，並支援真正的學習。

abstract.faithfulZh: 隨著時代的發展，程式設計教育對個人發展變得越來越重要。 然而，對於中小學生等程式設計初學者來說，學習程式設計並不是一項簡單的任務，需要額外的學習支援。 Generative AI (Genai) 聊天機器人是一種有效的教具，可以透過根據學生的能力提供實時指導和個性化學習支援來降低程式設計的學習難度。 因此，在教學中應用 Genai 聊天機器人一直是一種趨勢。 然而，技術總是有兩個方面。 過度依賴這些聊天機器人可能會削弱學生獨立思考的能力，並影響他們的學習效果。 因此，如何在課堂上合理利用 Genai 聊天機器人並提高其應用效率已成為研究人員和一線教師的一個重要問題。 基於此，本研究提出了一種將思維對映與 Genai 聊天機器人整合的學習方法。 為了評估這種學習方法的有效性，並研究各種型別的思維導圖支援的 Genai 聊天機器人對學生程式設計學習成績、運算思維和程式設計自我效能的影響是否存在差異，研究團隊進行了準實驗研究。 參與者是中國東南部一所中學的111名七年級學生。 實驗組 1（36 名學生）使用了一種學習方法，將漸進式思維圖與生成式 AI 聊天機器人整合，實驗組 2（36 名學生）使用學習方法，將自建思維圖與 Genai 聊天機器人整合，對照組（39 名學生）使用 傳統的基於AI聊天機器人的學習方法。 結果表明，兩個實驗組的參與者都比對照組具有更好的程式設計學習效能和運算思維，並且將漸進式思維對映與 Genai 聊天機器人相結合的學習方法更有效。

abstract.faithfulZh: 【摘要】：作為日常臨床護理實踐中的重要技能,批判性思維能力一直是護理教育的一個重要目標。 概念對映使護理專業的學生將新資訊與現有知識聯絡起來，並整合跨學科知識。 然而，在護理教育中缺乏與批判性思維能力和概念對映有關的證據。 本系統評價和薈萃分析的目的是評估概念對映在護理教育中批判性思維中的效果。 設計 本系統評價與系統評價和薈萃分析 (PRISMA) 的首選報告專案一致。 資料來源 在 PubMed、Web of Science、EMBASE、Cochrane Central Register of Controls of Controller Register (Central)、護理與聯合健康累積指數 (CINAHL) 和中國國家知識基礎設施 (CNKI) 中進行了搜尋。 檢索了比較概念對映和傳統教學方法的隨機對照試驗 (RCT)。 審查方法 資料由兩名審稿人根據資料提取表收集。 納入研究的方法學品質由其他兩名評審員評估。 使用平均差（MD）提供薈萃分析結果。 結果 13 項試驗總結在系統評價中，11 項試驗納入薈萃分析。 彙總效應量表明，與傳統方法相比，概念對映可以提高受試者的批判性思維能力，透過加州批判性思維處置量表 (CCTDI)、加州批判性思維技能測試 (CCTST) 和批判性思維量表 (CTS) 測量。 亞組分析表明，概念對映提高了所有子量表的分數。 結論 本綜述的結果表明，概念對映可以影響批判性思維情感傾向和批判性思維認知技能。 需要使用統一評估進行進一步的高品質研究。

previousSegments.sourceText: In the field of education, collaborative learning has been widely applied and is regarded as an effective instructional strategy for enhancing student learning (Gillies, 2003; Hron & Friedrich, 2003; Kokku et al., 2018). Several researchers have revealed that collaborative learning can significantly improve students’ academic performance (Rorimpandey et al., 2022; Suendarti & Virgana, 2022), collective efficacy (Gillies, 2019), critical thinking tendencies (Huang et al., 2017; Quines, 2017), as well as problem-solving and decision-making abilities (Knoche, 2022). These benefits can also be explained by Social Cognitive Theory, which emphasizes that learning occurs through social interaction and observational processes within a shared environment (Bandura, 1986, 2000). Building upon the foundations of collaborative learning, PBL has emerged as a structured approach that embodies its core principles. It is commonly regarded as a concrete form of collaborative learning, and is deeply inspired by the theory of social constructivism (Vygotsky, 1986). According to Vygotsky’s (1986) view of social constructivism, knowledge is constructed through social interaction, language communication, and collaborative activities in cultural contexts. In a PBL context, students discuss, reason, and share knowledge about real problems in small groups, and develop understanding and solutions through peer collaboration and reflection

translation.faithfulZh: 在教育領域，協作學習已被廣泛應用，被認為是增強學生學習的有效教學策略（Gillies，2003；Hron & Friedrich，2003；Kokku et al.，2018）。 一些研究人員表明，協作學習可以顯著提高學生的學習成績（Rorimpandey et al.，2022；Suendarti & Virgana，2022），集體效能（Gillies，2019），批判性思維趨勢 （Huang et al.，2017；Quines，2017），以及解決問題和決策能力（Knoche，2022）。 這些好處也可以用社會認知理論來解釋，它強調學習是透過共享環境中的社會互動和觀察過程發生的（Bandura，1986，2000）。 在協作學習的基礎上，PBL 已成為一種體現其核心原則的結構化方法。 它通常被認為是一種具體的協作學習形式，並深受社會建構主義理論的啟發（Vygotsky，1986）。 根據 Vygotsky (1986) 的社會建構主義觀點，知識是透過社會互動、語言交流和文化背景下的協作活動構建的。 在 PBL 背景下，學生在小組中討論、推理和分享有關實際問題的知識，並透過同行協作和反思來發展理解和解決方案
translation.plainZh: 協作學習廣泛應用於增強學生的學習、提高學業成績、集體效能、批判性思維和解決問題的能力。 這得到了社會認知理論的支援，它強調透過社互動動進行學習。 基於問題的學習 (PBL) 建立在協作學習原則之上，並受到社會建構主義的啟發，其中透過社會互動和協作構建知識。 PBL 涉及學生透過同伴協作和反思討論、推理和分享知識，以解決現實世界的問題。

It is recommended that future research explore how to integrate GAI with other personalized learning systems or to develop further personalized AI models that can automatically adjust content and teaching methods based on students’ learning situations and performance, thereby enhancing the educational applicability of AI tools. In this context, concept mapping can be incorporated as a visual and diagnostic tool to represent students’ cognitive structures, enabling the AI system to better identify learning gaps and tailor instructional prompts accordingly. 2. Future research should integrate GAI with various teaching modes, using it as a supplementary tool rather than as the primary learning pathway. Educators could combine AI technology with conventional teaching methods to foster collaboration and discussion between teachers and students, thereby balancing the importance of technological applications with interpersonal communication. 3. The convenience of immediate feedback provided by GAI may reduce opportunities for students to engage in independent thinking. If students become accustomed to relying on GAI for answers, they may neglect the underlying logical reasoning and analytical processes, potentially leading to a decline in their cognitive abilities. Therefore, it is recommended that future educators design challenging tasks that require students to reflect, summarize, and critique after using AI. For instance, students could be asked to further explain or expand upon the AI-generated answers, ensuring that they not only understand the results but also grasp the underlying processes and principles. 4. Since GAI’s responses are based on existing data and patterns, it may not be effective in terms of fostering students’ creative thinking, particularly in situations that require divergent thinking or innovative problem solving. Future research could explore how to integrate GAI with creative learning activities, such as designing tasks that ask students to critique or expand on AIgenerated answers, thereby stimulating their creative thinking. links.evidenceQuote: In the “Knowledge Organization” stage, each group collaboratively used MindMaster to construct a concept map that organized the information gathered from GAI (see Fig. 2). MindMaster was selected for its collaborative features, specifically allowing multiple students to simultaneously edit and visualize concept maps in real time. The students were guided to check the information from GAI and identify the relationships between the concepts underlying the information, such as “characteristics of sunset industries,” “labor protection,” and “environmental sustainability.” They then visualized the relationships by developing concept maps. The process of constructing a concept map was not only an integration of knowledge but also a test of students’ depth of understanding. This not only aided their own comprehension and memory, but also facilitated communication and discussion among group members. Therefore, constructing a concept map further promoted student communication and collaboration, ensuring that each member actively participated in knowledge construction.

This content comprised the learning outcomes inspired by students’ interactions with GAI and discussions with classmates. This process aligned with Vygotsky’s (1986) social constructivism, which emphasizes the promotion of knowledge internalization and construction through social interaction and collaborative learning. paper-06.title: Effects of integrating peer assessment with electromechanical game-based learning on enhancing AI learning and computational thinking of undergraduates
paper-06.sourceFileName: 6. Effects of integrating peer assessment with electromechanical game-based learning on enhancing AI learning and computational thinking of undergraduates.pdf

segments.sourceText: ABSTRACT Peer assessment and AIoT board games have emerged as effective game-based learning approaches for enhancing artificial intelligence (AI) education and computational thinking (CT). This study employs a four-group quasi-experimental design to examine their impact on undergraduate learning using a personal audio classifier (PAC). The AIoT board game integrates CT and AI concepts through collaborative, hands-on learning, incorporating peer assessment, problem-solving scenarios, and paired programming. Results indicate that anonymous online peer assessment fosters critical thinking and reduces learning anxiety. The AIoT board game enhances collaboration, creativity, and the practical application of AI concepts. Peer assessment further supports iterative improvement of PAC applications for gameplay. The integration of peer assessment within problem-solving tasks significantly improves learning outcomes, lowering barriers to AI education and preparing students for a technologydriven future. This study highlights the potential of combining AI instructional tools with peer assessment to deepen students’ understanding of AI and CT.

segments.sourceText: In the rapidly advancing landscape of modern technology, profound impacts have been exerted on numerous domains (Schmidhuber, 2015). Artificial Intelligence (AI) wields a profound influence on various professional fields, such as medical diagnosis, AI-driven job interviews, and big data analysis, among others. The development of these technologies has significantly altered our societal perceptions and perspectives, necessitating the cultivation of individuals’ abilities to operate or comprehend these technologies. One of the most fundamental and pivotal concepts therein is computational thinking (CT). In contemporary society, CT has evolved into an indispensable foundational skill for individuals (Yadav et al., 2014).

segments.sourceText: Research suggests that utilizing game-based learning can enhance and sustain students’ motivation (Alt, 2023) and engagement (Clark et al., 2016). Properly designed educational game content can facilitate deeper student thinking. In recent years, numerous researchers have integrated the concept of board games into education. Gee (2005) indicated that by establishing clear learning objectives, board games can become effective tools for promoting self-directed learning, problem solving, and in-depth learning. Due to their collaborative nature, board games enable students to experience educational content through social interaction, peer engagement, and mutual learning (Wu et al., 2014). Board games, as an educational tool, are also regarded as an important medium for practicing computational thinking (Bayeck, 2023). On the other hand, research on AI education points out that visualizing and gamifying AI course materials can effectively enhance students’ learning interest (DeNero & Klein, 2010).

segments.sourceText: The primary value of peer assessment lies in the close interaction among peers. Chang et al. In typical classroom scenarios, the number of students often far exceeds that of teachers, resulting in limited individual feedback from instructors. Peer assessment serves as a solution to this predicament, as research indicates that peer feedback can be more direct and personalized compared to feedback from teachers (Topping, 2009). From another perspective, teacher feedback is often perceived by students as authoritative and less open to challenge, while peer feedback tends to be more diverse. Furthermore, peer feedback can foster interactive discussions among students, even to the extent of promoting mutual engagement (Cole, 1991; Zhan et al., 2022).

Therefore, this study aimed to enhance students’ computational thinking in the four dimensions proposed by the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) in 2017, namely decomposition, pattern recognition, abstraction, and algorithms, through the utilization of AIoT board games and peer assessment. The following research questions were formulated:

segments.sourceText: CT has been recognized as a fundamental twenty-first-century competency that supports logical reasoning, problem solving, and innovation across disciplines (Voogt et al., 2015). Wing (2006) first conceptualized CT as a cognitive process of applying computer-science principles to formulate problems and design solutions that can be executed by humans or machines. Wing (2011) further emphasized abstraction as the core cognitive mechanism that enables the transfer of computational reasoning to diverse real-world contexts.

translation.faithfulZh: CT 已被公認為支援跨學科邏輯推理、問題解決和創新的基本 20 世紀能力（Voogt et al.，2015）。 Wing (2006) 首次將 CT 概念化為應用電腦科學原理來制定可以由人類或機器執行的問題和設計解決方案的認知過程。 Wing (2011) 進一步強調抽象作為核心認知機制，它能夠將計算推理轉移到不同的現實世界環境中。

segments.sourceText: Barr and Stephenson (2011) subsequently extended CT into a broader set of nine conceptual abilities: data collection, data analysis, data representation, decomposition, abstraction, algorithmic thinking, automation, parallelization, and simulation. These dimensions reflect the multidimensional nature of CT in the problemsolving process. Later, Selby and Woollard (2013) synthesized these conceptualizations into four essential elements: logical thinking processes, abstraction, decomposition, and problem-solving patterns. Their work clarified the interconnections among CT subskills and laid a foundation for pedagogical implementation.

translation.faithfulZh: Barr 和 Stephenson (2011) 隨後將 CT 擴充套件為更廣泛的九個概念能力：資料收集、資料分析、資料表示、分解、抽象、演算法思維、自動化、並行化和模擬。 這些維度反映了 CT 在問題解決過程中的多維性質。 後來，Selby 和 Woollard (2013) 將這些概念化為四個基本要素：邏輯思維過程、抽象、分解和解決問題的模式。 他們的工作澄清了 CT 子技能之間的相互聯絡，併為教學實施奠定了基礎。

segments.sourceText: Building on these developments, BBC proposed a more pedagogically practical and measurable framework that defines CT as the ability to give precise instructions to a computer on what to do next. The BBC model operationalizes CT through four key dimensions, namely decomposition, pattern recognition, abstraction, and algorithms, and provides a clear structure for classroom instruction and assessment. Compared with earlier frameworks that emphasized theoretical breadth, the BBC framework is concise, teachable, and directly applicable to computational learning activities. Because of its pedagogical clarity and applicability, this study adopted the BBC framework as the foundation for instructional design. All subsequent course activities and assessment instruments were developed based on this framework to ensure that each stage of learning incorporated the four CT dimensions, enabling students to decompose problems, recognize patterns, abstract core principles, and design algorithms to address authentic learning challenges.

translation.faithfulZh: 基於這些發展，BBC 提出了一個更具教學實用性和可衡量的框架，將 CT 定義為向計算機提供精確指示的能力，說明下一步該做什麼。 BBC 模型透過分解、模式識別、抽象和演算法四個關鍵維度實現 CT 操作，併為課堂教學和評估提供了清晰的結構。 與強調理論廣度的早期框架相比，BBC 框架簡潔、可教且直接適用於計算學習活動。 由於其教學清晰度和適用性，本研究採用 BBC 框架作為教學設計的基礎。 所有後續課程活動和評估工具都是基於該框架開發的，以確保學習的每個階段都結合了四個 CT 維度，使學生能夠分解問題、識別模式、抽象的核心原則和設計演算法，以應對真實的學習挑戰。
translation.plainZh: BBC 提出了一個實用的 CT 框架，將其定義為向計算機提供指令。 該框架側重於四個維度：分解、模式識別、抽象和演算法，為教學和評估提供了簡潔和適用的結構。 本研究採用了 BBC 框架的教學清晰度。

segments.sourceText: Board games have been shown to aid students in cultivating critical thinking, problem-solving abilities, situation analysis, inference, organization, planning, and communication skills (Hinebaugh, 2009). The use of board games for developing educational competencies is not a contemporary phenomenon; its origins can be traced back to as early as 2200 BC. To date, numerous schools have successfully integrated board games into their curricula. Many schools in a certain city in the United States have incorporated games such as Monopoly and Checkers to enhance students’ mathematical skills. Oktaviane et al. (2021) developed a competitive board game to help students learn to classify snakes. The results found that competitive board games have a positive impact on students and make learning full of interactions and interesting.

segments.sourceText: Compared to traditional learning, incorporating educational board games into the curriculum can further aid students in developing logical thinking, critical thinking, and deductive reasoning skills (Hinebaugh, 2009). In the past, many subjects such as mathematics, language, history, and science have been taught using conventional methods. However, in order to enhance learning effectiveness, motivate students, and pique their interest, educators have infused elements of board games into the curriculum. This integration allows students to engage in communication with others through board games, thereby enhancing their interpersonal communication skills (Charlier & De Fraine, 2013). On another note, Cheng (2018) employed educational board games for language learning, revealing that such an approach effectively improved students’ learning effectiveness while also reducing their learning anxiety.

segments.sourceText: Peer assessment is a mode of evaluation whereby learners assess one another, typically those with similar levels of learning, and has been successfully applied in primary, middle, and high schools, even among very young students and those with special educational needs or learning disabilities (Ehly & Topping, 1998). Furthermore, a substantial body of research demonstrates that peer assessment enhances learning effectiveness (Cartney, 2010; Cartney & Rouse, 2006; Cassidy, 2006; Clegg & Bryan, 2006; Panadero et al., 2016; Topping et al., 2000). Importantly, both assessors and those being assessed benefit from this process. They can identify their own shortcomings through evaluating their peers’ work, and can also recognize others’ weaknesses, leading to improvement (Yorke, 2003; Zhan et al., 2023). However, in countries where the primary educational approach involves teacher guidance and does not encourage independent thinking, students may not be receptive to peer assessment (Topping, 2023).

translation.faithfulZh: 同伴評估是一種評估模式，學習者彼此評估，通常是具有相似學習水平的人，並已成功應用於小學、初中和高中，即使在非常年輕的學生和有特殊教育需求或學習障礙的學生中也是如此（Ehly & Topping，1998）。 此外，大量研究表明，同伴評估可以提高學習效果（Cartney, 2010; Cartney & Rouse, 2006; Cassidy, 2006; Clegg & Bryan, 2006; Panadero et al.，2016；Topping et al.，2000）。 重要的是，評估員和被評估的人都從這個過程中受益。 他們可以透過評估同行的工作來識別自己的缺點，也可以識別他人的弱點，從而導致改進（Yorke，2003；Zhan et al.，2023）。 然而，在小學教育方法涉及教師指導並且不鼓勵獨立思考的國家，學生可能無法接受同伴評估（Topping，2023）。
translation.plainZh: 同伴評估，學習者相互評估，已成功應用於各種教育水平。 研究表明，它提高了評估員和被評估人員的學習效果，幫助確定了優勢和劣勢。

segments.sourceText: In online peer assessment, Cheng and Tsai (2012) found that higher psychological safety, lower goal value diversity, greater trust in oneself as an assessor, and more positive social interdependence contribute to cultivating deeper learning. An important feature of online peer assessment is its anonymity, which presents both advantages and disadvantages (Li, 2017). Previous research has indicated that anonymous peer assessment seems to offer advantages in terms of students’ perceptions of the learning value of peer assessment. It can provide more critical peer feedback and enhance the social effects of self-perception. This is particularly evident in higher education and contexts with fewer peer assessment scenarios (Panadero & Alqassab, 2019).

segments.sourceText: The scale used in this study was derived from the Technology Acceptance Scale compiled by Venkatesh (2000). The original questionnaire had 44 questions and a total of eight aspects. Chang (2014) adapted the scale into the Learning Anxiety and Learning Engagement Scale, which is used to assess the learning anxiety, playfulness and enjoyment felt by students during the learning process. As the Technology Acceptance Scale was originally designed as a generalized instrument, its items can be flexibly adapted by modifying the subject terms to fit different domains (Venkatesh, 2000). Following Chang (2014), we rephrased items to align with the learning context (e.g. shifting focus from “system use” to “learning activity experience”) while maintaining the three-factor structure, ensuring content relevance and construct validity. segments.sourceText: The study also examined students’ learning behaviors during the learning activities. Due to the influence of COVID-19, Experimental Group 2 (EG2) conducted the instruction online, making it impossible to record students’ activity behaviors. Learning behaviors exhibited in both inter-group and intra-group activities were captured for the other groups. Based on the actual actions of students recorded in videos, Table 1 presents a corresponding behavior identification encoding scheme for each category. To enhance transparency, the criteria for behavioral coding were further clarified. Active behaviors referred to initiating actions such as proposing ideas, operating devices, or leading group discussions, while passive behaviors referred to responding or following instructions without initiating. A coding manual was established, and sample cases were used during coder training to improve inter-rater consistency and repeatability. An expert with experience in AIoT board games and peer assessment research was invited to validate the coding scheme to ensure the reliability of behavior analysis in the study. The expert, alongside researchers, examined the applicability of codes and their respective descriptions and definitions. Each 30-second interval was identified with a code, and video coding techniques were employed to investigate key actions. Additionally, a trained coder participated in the coding process alongside the researchers. The kappa value of .84 indicated good internal consistency, and any inconsistent results were resolved through discussion between the two coders to reach a consensus.

segments.sourceText: Figure 7 presents the behavioral pattern of EG1. During the initial phase of model building and testing, students followed discussion and idea-sharing with immediate implementation (EO→GC→OT, GC→EO→OT). While conducting robot car testing and gameplay, discussion preceded the students’ actions with the robot car (GC→P). In case of errors, they backtracked to debugging, and after resolution, testing followed (D→P, P→D). Similar to EG3, the same situation occurred during gameplay, and this situation recurred more frequently (P→D).

segments.sourceText: To examine the learning achievements of the four groups of students, we employed a one-way ANOVA and post-hoc tests. Based on the experimental results, all three experimental groups exhibited significantly higher learning achievements compared to the control group. These results indicate that regardless of whether AIoT board games, peer assessment, or a combination of both were employed, students’ learning achievements were significantly higher than those who learned with traditional teaching methods.

translation.faithfulZh: 為了檢查四組學生的學習成績，我們採用了單向方差分析和事後測試。 根據實驗結果，與對照組相比，所有三個實驗組的學習成效都顯著提高。 這些結果表明，無論是 AIoT 棋盤遊戲、同行評估還是兩者的結合，學生的學習成績都明顯高於使用傳統教學方法學習的學生。
translation.plainZh: 使用單向方差分析和事後測試來評估學習成效。 無論干預型別如何，所有三個實驗組（AIOT、同行評估、組合）的成就都明顯高於對照組。

segments.sourceText: This result underscores the effectiveness of peer assessment in enhancing students’ learning achievements, as active participation in both learning and evaluative activities fosters greater engagement and responsibility in learning processes (Hodgson et al., 2014). Through peer assessment, students evaluate their peers’ work, critically examine their own performance, and become more invested in the course, thereby elevating their overall learning achievements. This reflective process also promotes higher-order thinking, as students analyze and provide constructive feedback, deepening their understanding of the subject matter (Zhan et al., 2023).

translation.faithfulZh: 這一結果強調了同伴評估在提高學生學習成就方面的有效性，因為積極參與學習和評估活動可以促進更大的參與度和對學習過程的責任感（Hodgson et al.，2014）。 透過同行評估，學生評估同伴的工作，批判性地檢查自己的表現，並在課程中投入更多的資金，從而提高他們的整體學習成績。 這種反思過程也促進了高階思維，因為學生分析和提供建設性的回饋，加深了他們對主題的理解（Zhan et al.，2023）。
translation.plainZh: 同行評估透過增加參與度、責任感和反思性思維來增強學習，最終導致更高的學習成就（Hodgson et al.，2014；Zhan et al.，2023）。

segments.sourceText: Furthermore, the AIoT board games employed in this study provided students with a collaborative and interactive learning environment that facilitated face-to-face discussions, cognitive engagement, and teamwork, all of which enhance learning outcomes (Lin & Hou, 2022). The descriptive results revealed a performance trend of EG3 > EG2 > EG1 > CG. This pattern suggests that students who participated solely in the AIoT game condition (EG3) achieved slightly higher learning performance than those in the peer assessment (EG2) or combined intervention (EG1) groups. One plausible explanation is that integrating peer assessment into the AIoT gameplay may have increased task complexity and cognitive load, as students had to manage both strategic gameplay and evaluative responsibilities. According to cognitive load theory, engaging in multiple cognitively demanding tasks simultaneously can impose extraneous load, potentially diminishing short-term performance (Sweller, 2010).

translation.faithfulZh: 此外，本研究中使用的 AIoT 棋盤遊戲為學生提供了一個協作和互動的學習環境，促進了面對面的討論、認知參與和團隊合作，所有這些都可以提高學習成效（Lin & Hou, 2022）。 描述性結果揭示了 EG3 > EG2 > EG1 > CG 的效能趨勢。 這種模式表明，僅參與 AIoT 遊戲條件 (EG3) 的學生的學習成績略高於同伴評估 (EG2) 或聯合干預 (EG1) 組的學生。 一種合理的解釋是，將同行評估整合到 AIoT 遊戲中可能會增加任務的複雜性和認知負荷，因為學生必須同時管理戰略遊戲玩法和評估職責。 根據認知負荷理論，同時參與多個認知要求高的任務會帶來無關的負荷，可能會降低短期表現（Sweller，2010）。
translation.plainZh: AIoT 棋盤遊戲創造了一個促進討論、參與和團隊合作的協作學習環境，從而改善了學習成效（Lin & Hou, 2022）。 EG3（僅限 AIOT）的表現略好於 EG2（僅對等評估）或 EG1（組合）。

segments.sourceText: Another possible explanation is related to learning motivation and flow. The AIoT board game alone might have elicited stronger intrinsic motivation and a higher level of flow experience due to its competitive and playful nature, resulting in higher immediate learning outcomes (Hamari et al., 2016). In contrast, adding peer assessment may have disrupted the game’s immersive flow by introducing evaluative pauses that shifted students’ focus toward reflection rather than immediate gameplay. Nevertheless, peer assessment is particularly valuable for developing reflective, metacognitive, and self-regulatory abilities, which may not immediately manifest in performance scores but contribute to sustainable learning benefits over time (Double et al., 2020).

translation.faithfulZh: 另一種可能的解釋與學習動機和流動有關。 由於AIoT棋盤遊戲的競爭性和有趣性，它可能會引起更強的內在動機和更高水平的流體驗，從而產生更高的即時學習成效（Hamari et al.，2016）。 相比之下，新增同行評估可能透過引入評估性停頓來擾亂遊戲的沉浸式流程，將學生的注意力轉移到反思上，而不是立即的遊戲玩法。 儘管如此，同行評估對於發展反思性、元認知和自我調節能力特別有價值，這些能力可能不會立即體現在績效分數中，而是有助於隨著時間的推移對可持續學習的好處做出貢獻（Double et al.，2020）。
translation.plainZh: 將同伴評估整合到 AIoT 遊戲中的複雜性增加可能會產生無關的認知負荷，可能會阻礙短期表現（Sweller，2010）。 AIoT 遊戲的內在動機和流量可能會更高，從而立即提高效能（Hamari et al.，2016）。

segments.sourceText: Ultimately, this study demonstrates that all three innovative approaches, AIoT game-based learning, peer assessment, and their combination, effectively enhance students’ learning achievements compared with traditional instruction. The integrated approach (EG1) may therefore serve a complementary rather than additive role, balancing the motivational and collaborative benefits of gameplay with the reflective depth fostered by peer assessment.

translation.faithfulZh: 最終，本研究表明，與傳統教學相比，所有三種創新方法，基於 AIoT 遊戲的學習、同伴評估及其組合，有效地提高了學生的學習成績。 因此，綜合方法 (EG1) 可以提供互補而不是附加作用，平衡遊戲玩法的動機和協作益處與同行評估所促進的反思深度。

segments.sourceText: To examine the CT self-efficacy of the four student groups, we employed the Kruskal–Wallis H test and posthoc U test. Based on the experimental results, significant differences were observed in the aspects of cooperative learning and creative thinking. However, no significant differences were found in problem-solving and algorithmic thinking. One possible explanation is that these dimensions typically require more extended practice and repeated opportunities for application to show measurable changes (Voogt et al., 2015). The short two-week intervention may not have been sufficient to yield observable improvements in these specific areas.

segments.sourceText: In this study, students engaged in cooperative tasks while training voice recognition models. However, EG2 conducted their learning activities in an online environment, which made it more challenging for them to engage in effective cooperation. This difficulty likely contributed to their poorer performance in the aspect of cooperative learning. This modality difference highlights a limitation of the study, as the lower cooperative learning performance in EG2 may be partially attributed to the online learning context rather than the peer assessment intervention itself. On the other hand, the groups that participated in AIoT board games, as seen in this study, demonstrated better performance in the aspect of creative thinking. Engaging in AIoT board games likely stimulated new ideas among the students, aligning with previous research findings (Bayeck, 2023; Carter et al., 2014).

segments.sourceText: To examine the learning anxiety and engagement of the four student groups, we employed the Kruskal– Wallis H test and post-hoc U test. According to the experimental results, significant differences were found only in the aspect of learning anxiety. In contrast, playfulness and enjoyment did not show significant differences across groups. This may be because these affective dimensions are more closely related to students’ intrinsic interest and prior attitudes toward games, which are less likely to change substantially within a short intervention period (Lin & Hou, 2022). Thus, while the AIoT game and peer assessment successfully influenced anxiety levels, they did not necessarily alter broader affective dispositions in the limited timeframe.

translation.faithfulZh: 為了檢查四個學生群體的學習焦慮和參與度，我們採用了 Kruskal-Wallis H 測試和事後 U 測試。 根據實驗結果，僅在學習焦慮方面發現了顯著差異。 相比之下，嬉戲和享受並沒有顯示出各組之間的顯著差異。 這可能是因為這些情感維度與學生的內在興趣和對遊戲的先驗態度更密切相關，這些維度在短時間內不太可能發生重大變化（Lin & Hou, 2022）。 因此，雖然 AIoT 博弈和同伴評估成功地影響了焦慮水平，但它們並不一定會在有限的時間範圍內改變更廣泛的情感傾向。
translation.plainZh: Kruskal–Wallis H 檢驗和事後 U 檢驗僅顯示四組的學習焦慮存在顯著差異。 玩耍和享受沒有顯著差異，可能是因為它們與內在的興趣和先前的態度有關（Lin & Hou, 2022）。

segments.sourceText: The post-hoc U test results indicated that EG3 had significantly higher levels of learning anxiety compared to both EG1 and EG2. To further examine whether this difference resulted from pre-existing individual variations, we analyzed the pretest data on learning anxiety. The results showed no significant differences among the four groups, suggesting that the higher anxiety observed in EG3 was not attributable to prior individual differences or baseline affective states. Instead, it may have arisen from situational factors during gameplay, such as time pressure or the competitive and problem-solving nature of the AIoT board game. This aligns with previous findings that challenge-induced tension in game-based learning can elicit facilitative anxiety, which enhances attention and persistence rather than hindering performance (Bandura, 1977; Zeidner, 1998). Prior studies have shown that in digital game-based learning environments, high-anxiety learners can still achieve strong learning performance when their engagement in gaming activities supports their learning processes (Yang et al., 2018). This suggests that the anxiety observed in EG3 might have coexisted with effective learning behaviors rather than directly impairing performance.

translation.faithfulZh: 事後 U 測試結果表明，與 EG1 和 EG2 相比，EG3 的學習焦慮水平顯著更高。 為了進一步檢查這種差異是否是由預先存在的個體差異引起的，我們分析了學習焦慮的預測試資料。 結果顯示四組之間沒有顯著差異，表明在 EG3 中觀察到的較高焦慮不是歸因於先前的個體差異或基線情感狀態。 相反，它可能是由遊戲中的情境因素引起的，例如時間壓力或 AIoT 棋盤遊戲的競爭和解決問題的性質。 這與之前的研究結果一致，即挑戰引起的基於遊戲的學習緊張會引起促進焦慮，這會增強注意力和永續性，而不是阻礙表現（Bandura，1977；Zeidner，1998）。 先前的研究表明，在基於數字遊戲的學習環境中，高焦慮的學習者在參與遊戲活動支援他們的學習過程時仍然可以獲得強大的學習表現（Yang et al.，2018）。 這表明在 EG3 中觀察到的焦慮可能與有效的學習行為共存，而不是直接損害表現。
translation.plainZh: 與 EG1 和 EG2 相比，EG3 的學習焦慮明顯更高，這不是由於預先存在的差異。 遊戲過程中的情境因素（時間壓力、遊戲機制）可能導致這種焦慮，這可能會自相矛盾地增強注意力（Bandura，1977；Zeidner，1998）。

segments.sourceText: In contrast, the peer assessment groups exhibited lower learning anxiety. In this study, students in the peer assessment conditions were provided with structured evaluation forms outlining assessment criteria and performance indicators. These explicit rubrics guided students’ project development and peer evaluation, reducing uncertainty and fostering confidence in their performance (Topping, 2009). Additionally, we further examined whether affective factors such as playfulness, enjoyment, and learning anxiety could predict or moderate learning performance. The regression analyses revealed no significant effects, suggesting that these affective constructs did not directly influence students’ learning outcomes in this study.

Students in CG and EG3, however, tended to spend more time working individually on debugging or task execution, indicating that peer assessment contributed to richer social and cognitive engagement.

segments.sourceText: This study examined the impact of AIoT board games and peer assessment on undergraduate students’ learning of CT and AI. The results indicated that all three experimental conditions, AIoT board game only, peer assessment only, and the combined approach, significantly outperformed traditional instruction in learning achievement and CT self-efficacy. Descriptive results revealed a performance pattern of EG3 > EG2 > EG1 > CG, suggesting that while the AIoT board game alone yielded the highest short-term learning gains, the combined approach provided complementary benefits by integrating the motivational engagement of gameplay with the reflective and metacognitive processes fostered through peer assessment. Sequential behavior analysis further confirmed that peer assessment effectively facilitated discussions and interactions, enriching collaborative learning processes. Notably, despite undergoing online instruction, EG2 achieved higher learning gains than the control group, reinforcing the robustness of peer feedback as an effective learning strategy even in virtual environments. Future research should explore the applicability of these methods across disciplines to broaden their educational impact and sustainability.

segments.sourceText: Despite the positive findings, this study has several limitations. First, EG2 was conducted online due to the COVID-19 pandemic, whereas the other groups were conducted face-to-face. This difference in modality may have confounded the effects of peer assessment, particularly with respect to cooperative learning outcomes. Second, the learning achievement test showed relatively low reliability (KR-20 values below .70), which may have introduced measurement errors. Although the CT self-efficacy scale demonstrated acceptable internal consistency after item selection, further validation studies are recommended to strengthen its applicability in different contexts. Finally, the short intervention period of two weeks (six hours in total) is acknowledged as a limitation, since cultivating higher-order thinking skills such as critical and computational thinking requires repeated practice, iterative reflection, and longer-term engagement (Voogt et al., 2015; Wing, 2011). Shortterm interventions may primarily influence surface-level behaviors, such as modifying assignments according to criteria, rather than fundamentally reshaping thinking modes. Future studies should therefore adopt extended interventions, incorporate repeated practice cycles, and include delayed post-tests to capture the gradual and sustained development of higher-order thinking, in line with the progressive nature of educational learning processes.

translation.faithfulZh: 儘管有積極的發現，但這項研究有幾個侷限性。 首先，由於COVID-19大流行，EG2是線上進行的，而其他組則是面對面進行的。 這種方式的差異可能混淆了同行評估的影響，特別是在合作學習結果方面。 其次，學習成績測試顯示出相對較低的可靠性（KR-20 值低於 0.70），這可能引入了測量誤差。 儘管 CT 自我效能量表在專案選擇後表現出可接受的內部一致性，但建議進一步驗證研究以加強其在不同環境中的適用性。 最後，兩週（總共六小時）的短時間干預期被認為是一個侷限性，因為培養批判性和運算思維等更高階思維技能需要反覆練習、迭代反思和長期參與（Voogt et al.， 2015；翼，2011）。 短期干預可能主要影響表面水平的行為，例如根據標準修改分配，而不是從根本上重塑思維模式。 因此，未來的研究應採用擴充套件干預措施，包括重複的實踐週期，幷包括延遲後測以捕捉高階思維的逐漸和持續發展，符合教育學習過程的漸進性質。

abstract.faithfulZh: 印度尼西亞的地中海貧血患者數量預計每年都會增加。 這種遺傳疾病可能對患者、家屬、看護人和政府造成心理影響和鉅額費用。 本研究旨在分析感知障礙 (PB) 與考慮未來後果 (CFC) 之間的相關性，以及它們與行為意向 (BI) 的相互作用，以進行地中海貧血篩查，作為預防性健康行為 (PHB) 的一部分。 參與者是 411 名年輕人，年齡在 18 至 25 歲之間（M = 20.47）。 研究中使用的測量結果是 PHB 量表、CFC-14 量表和 BI 量表的適應版本。 過程迴歸分析的主要結果表明，(1) PB 對 BI 的負面且顯著的影響（B1 = -0.0089；P < 0.05），（2）CFC 對 BI 的影響不顯著（B2 = 0.0096；P > 0.05), (3) Pb 和 Cfc 的相互作用對 Bi 的影響不大 (b3 = -0.0005; p > 0.05)。 作為受控變數的自我效能感與 BI 具有顯著相關性，併成為制定 PHB 意圖的強有力預測因素。 這項研究得出的結論是，障礙仍然是決定某人 PHB 的主要因素。 患者的知識越詳細，他們就越認為障礙是挑戰，因此他們的 PHB 效果越高。

abstract.originalText: Abstract Peer assessments (PA) have been widely explored by researchers over the past few decades. However, their impact on various learning environments remains unclear. Based
abstract.faithfulZh: 在過去的幾十年裡，研究人員廣泛探索了同行評估 (PA)。 然而，它們對各種學習環境的影響仍不清楚。 基於薈萃分析，本研究旨在分析跨多種學習環境進行的基於 PA 的研究。 然而，與現有的薈萃分析不同，本研究將共同引用網路分析與薈萃分析相結合，以檢查分析研究之間的文獻計量關係。 這種方法提供了基於引用的證據來確保研究資料的關聯以進行薈萃分析。 此外，視覺化研究網路提供了對 PA 文獻的全新微觀到宏觀理解。 總共收集了 20 篇與 PA 相關的核心文章，其中包括他們的後續 340 項引用研究，基於系統的關鍵字搜尋。 所有分析的文章均於 1998 年至 2020 年間發表，並來自兩個著名的資料庫，即 Web of Science 和 Scopus，以保持用於本研究的資料的品質。 主要發現是雙重的。 首先，薈萃分析報告說，實驗組和對照組之間平均差異在 95% 置信區間的標準誤差為 [0.288, 0.424]，表明薈萃分析中的每個效應值都是異質的。 我們還發現，結合 PA 教學方法的技術在基於 Web 的問題解決活動的背景下具有一定的學習效果。 此外，根據 Fu 和 Hwang (2018) 的建構主義理論框架，我們提出了一些進行同行評估研究的標準。 其次，共同引用網路分析呈現了 20 篇 PA 文章的視覺化網路結構，其中 11 篇是書目相連的。 這一結果與之前的研究相呼應，回顧了薈萃分析中研究之間的關係。 此外，PA 研究的共同引用網路揭示了 11 篇核心文章中的一些沉重的共同引用連結。 結果進一步確定了主要的研究焦點包括將 PA 與技術增強的學習環境（例如，基於遊戲和網路的學習）和 PA 活動相結合，用於該領域的協作學習。 總之，本研究提出了一種創新的方法來檢查實證 PA 研究的效果，因此為未來的研究提供了討論和方向。

abstract.faithfulZh: 線上同行評估 (OPA) 已被越來越多地用於發展學生的高階思維 (HOT)。 然而，關於其影響的研究結果還沒有綜合。 為了填補這一空白，有 17 篇論文（從 2000 年到 2022 年發表）報告了使用 OPA (n = 7; k = 22) 的組與對照組或前後比較 (n = 10; k = 17) 在本薈萃分析中進行了回顧。 OPA 對熱的總體影響是顯著的（g = 0.76）。 此外，OPA 對收斂熱（例如，批判性思維、推理和反思性思維；g = 0.97）比對發散熱（例如，創造力和解決問題；g = 0.38）產生了更顯著的影響。 發現互惠作用和匿名性可以積極調節 OPA 對熱的影響，儘管由於分析中的研究樣本量較小，它們的調節作用沒有統計學意義。 薈萃分析的結果強化了將 OPA 作為促進學生熱發展的有力學習工具的論點，並揭示了在採用 OPA 以增強學生的熱度時應考慮的重要因素。 從業者注意到關於該主題的線上同行評估 (OPA) 對學習成績有顯著的積極影響。 OPA 一直被認為是培養學生高階思維 (HOT) 的一種潛在方法，但尚未透過薈萃分析得到證實。 OPA 應經過精心設計，以最大限度地提高其在學習上的有效性。 本文新增的 OPA 已被證明對學生的熱量產生了顯著的積極影響，透過薈萃分析。 OPA 對收斂熱的影響比發散熱更顯著。 不應低估互惠角色和匿名性對 OPA 對熱影響的影響的潛力。 當從業者幫助學生實現熱點性格和技能的平衡發展時，對實踐和/或政策的影響可能是從業者的明智選擇。 可以鼓勵學生在接受同伴回饋時的不同熱點，並允許他們自主決定評估標準。 具有互惠角色和匿名性的設計元素的 OPA 具有促進學生熱度的巨大潛力。

An expert with experience in AIoT board games and peer assessment research was invited to validate the coding scheme to ensure the reliability of behavior analysis in the study. Each 30-second interval was identified with a code, and video coding techniques were employed to investigate key actions. Additionally, a trained coder participated in the coding process alongside the researchers. links.evidenceQuote: The post-hoc U test results indicated that EG3 had significantly higher levels of learning anxiety compared to both EG1 and EG2. To further examine whether this difference resulted from pre-existing individual variations, we analyzed the pretest data on learning anxiety. The results showed no significant differences among the four groups, suggesting that the higher anxiety observed in EG3 was not attributable to prior individual differences or baseline affective states. Instead, it may have arisen from situational factors during gameplay, such as time pressure or the competitive and problem-solving nature of the AIoT board game. This aligns with previous findings that challenge-induced tension in game-based learning can elicit facilitative anxiety, which enhances attention and persistence rather than hindering performance (Bandura, 1977; Zeidner, 1998). Prior studies have shown that in digital game-based learning environments, high-anxiety learners can still achieve strong learning performance when their engagement in gaming activities supports their learning processes (Yang et al., 2018). This suggests that the anxiety observed in EG3 might have coexisted with effective learning behaviors rather than directly impairing performance.

segments.sourceText: Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) education is widely recognised as a crucial approach for enhancing students' scientific literacy, critical thinking, and abilities to solve interdisciplinary problems (English 2023). Integrating science, technology, engineering, and mathematics into real-world scenarios, STEM education fosters students' autonomous exploration and innovative practises, deepening their disciplinary knowledge and honing their problem-solving skills (Tan et al. 2023). As educational technologies evolve, the importance of STEM education has become more prominent in the educational sector (Li et al. 2020). Yet, its practical application encounters numerous challenges, such as the abstract nature of scientific knowledge (Qian and Choi 2023), the complexity of learning materials (Gao et al. 2020), and traditional teaching methods falling short when it comes to motivating students intrinsically, thus limiting their learning motivation and effectiveness (Lin and Wang 2021). From a cognitive science perspective, these challenges can impose a high cognitive load on students, hindering their ability to effectively process information and engage in deep learning (Sweller 1994). The question of how to effectively create realistic learning environments that enable students to comprehend and apply abstract and complex concepts is now a central concern in educational research and practise (Chernikova et al. 2020).

segments.sourceText: ABSTRACT Background: STEM education aims to develop innovation and problem-solving skills through interdisciplinary learning, yet struggles to foster student engagement and interdisciplinary thinking. Whilst alternate reality games (ARGs) can boost motivation via game-based problem-solving, integrating large language models (LLMs) remains underexplored. LLM-based virtual agents offer new opportunities for adaptive support. Objectives: This study aimed to investigate the effectiveness of an LLM-assisted ARG system (LLM-ARG) in enhancing academic performance, metacognitive awareness, and engagement. Methods: A quasi-experimental study compared LLM-ARG with conventional ARG methods amongst primary school students. The experimental group used LLM-ARG with personalised virtual agent support, whilst the control group employed a conventional ARG with a traditional, rule-based virtual agent that offered only pre-scripted feedback. Data were collected through pre-and post-tests, metacognitive awareness questionnaires, and interaction logs. ANCOVA and correlation analyses were conducted. Results and Conclusions: LLM-ARG significantly improved learning achievements and metacognitive awareness compared to conventional ARG. High-frequency interactions promoted exploration but did not consistently enhance problem-solving, whilst low-frequency interactions led to higher success via goal-directed strategies. Metacognitive competence emerged as a key predictor of academic performance, highlighting the need to balance exploration with efficiency. This study demonstrates how LLM-driven scaffolding supports diverse learning strategies and promotes adaptive learning in STEM education.

translation.faithfulZh: 背景：STEM 教育旨在透過跨領域學習培養創新與問題解決能力，但在促進學生投入及跨領域思考方面仍面臨困難。另類實境遊戲（ARG）可透過遊戲式問題解決提升動機，但將大型語言模型（LLM）整合其中的作法仍少有研究；以 LLM 為基礎的虛擬代理人則為適性支援帶來新機會。目的：本研究探討 LLM 輔助 ARG 系統（LLM-ARG）提升學業表現、後設認知覺察與投入程度的成效。方法：研究採準實驗設計，比較國小學生使用 LLM-ARG 與傳統 ARG 的差異。實驗組使用具有個人化虛擬代理人支援的 LLM-ARG；控制組則使用傳統 ARG，其中規則式虛擬代理人只能提供預先編寫的回饋。研究以學習前後測、後設認知覺察問卷及互動紀錄蒐集資料，並進行共變數分析與相關分析。結果與結論：相較於傳統 ARG，LLM-ARG 顯著提升學習成就與後設認知覺察。高頻互動會促進探索，但不一定能改善問題解決；低頻互動者反而能透過目標導向策略取得較高成功率。後設認知能力是學業表現的重要預測因子，顯示探索與效率之間需要取得平衡。本研究說明 LLM 驅動的支架如何支持不同學習策略，並促進 STEM 教育中的適性學習。
translation.plainZh: 研究用 LLM 虛擬代理人取代只能回覆固定內容的傳統代理人。學生的成績與後設認知有所提升，但問得多不代表解題一定更好；有目標、有效率地使用代理人，比單純增加互動次數更重要。

segments.sourceText: Alternate Reality Games (ARGs) are interactive narratives that use the real world as a platform, often blurring the line between the game and reality (Örnebring 2007). Unlike typical games that are confined to a screen, ARGs integrate digital content with real-world locations and tasks to create an immersive, trans-media experience (Jagoda et al. 2015). Grounded in situated learning theory, they are extensively employed to kindle students' passion for learning and to promote their active engagement (Gilliam et al. 2017; Meekaew and Ketpichainarong 2021). Through the creation of puzzles and challenges, ARGs effectively boost students' motivation to learn (Hou et al. 2023; Sofianidis et al. 2024) and facilitate their problem-solving in blended virtual and real settings (Stylianidou et al. 2020). Although ARGs are widely recognised for their significant potential to foster active inquiry, research indicates that many students struggle with the organisation and processing of complex real-world information, which impacts their performance in ARG tasks (Whitton et al. 2014). For example, the overload of multimodal information, including visual, auditory, and textual data, can increase cognitive load, thereby reducing students' efficiency of information processing (Moon and Ryu 2021). To unlock the full potential of ARGs in STEM education, it is vital to provide tailored learning support that assists students in navigating challenges encountered during the inquiry process, thus boosting their inquiry skills and educational outcomes (Liang et al. 2021).

segments.sourceText: Chatbots driven by generative artificial intelligence, acting as virtual agents, have shown substantial promise in advancing human-computer interactions within educational settings (Yan et al. 2024). Large Language Models (LLMs) employed in these chatbots have witnessed rapid advancements recently, particularly in the fields of knowledge retrieval, text recognition, and multimodal interactions, which have notably increased the chatbots' potential in educational applications (Kuhail et al. 2023). LLM-based chatbots, by providing instantaneous feedback and supplementary information, effectively aid students in problem solving, and are recognised as personal tutors or learning assistants that can be seamlessly incorporated into educational systems (Dokukina and Gumanova 2020; Essel et al. 2022). Supported by extensive data, these chatbots not only manage information efficiently, but also enhance student engagement and problem resolution, delivering tailored learning feedback (Chen et al. 2023; Kasneci et al. 2023). Nonetheless, the integration of LLM technology into complex situational learning tasks remains underexplored, with most studies focusing primarily on its application in online learning platforms (Ooi et al. 2023). Whilst prior research has established the benefits of adaptive feedback, the unique affordances of LLMs—such as their ability to engage in natural language dialogue, provide explanatory feedback, and offer metacognitive scaffolding—remain underexplored within immersive learning environments (Du 2025; El Hajji et al. 2025).

translation.faithfulZh: 由生成人工智慧驅動的聊天機器人作為虛擬代理在教育環境中推進人機互動方面顯示出巨大的希望（Yan et al. 2024）。 這些聊天機器人中使用的大型語言模型（LLM）最近見證了快速發展，特別是在知識檢索、文字識別和多模態互動領域，這顯著增加了聊天機器人在教育應用中的潛力（Kuhail et al.） 2023)。 基於法學碩士的聊天機器人透過提供即時回饋和補充資訊，有效地幫助學生解決問題，並被公認為可以無縫整合到教育系統中的個人導師或學習助手（Dokukina 和 Gumanova 2020； Essel et al. 2022）。 在大量資料的支援下，這些聊天機器人不僅有效地管理資訊，還可以增強學生的參與度和問題解決方案，提供量身定製的學習回饋（Chen et al. 2023；Kasneci et al. 2023）。 儘管如此，將 LLM 技術整合到複雜的情境學習任務中的探索仍未得到充分探索，大多數研究主要集中在線上學習平臺中的應用（Ooi et al. 2023）。 雖然先前的研究已經確立了適應性回饋的好處，但 LLM 的獨特可供性——例如它們參與自然語言對話、提供解釋性回饋和提供元認知腳手架的能力——在沉浸式學習環境中仍未被充分探索（DU） 2025；El Hajji et al. 2025）。

segments.sourceText: ARGs have been successfully integrated into classroom educational practises (Christopoulos et al. 2023; Jesionkowska et al. 2020), with studies affirming their ability to markedly boost student engagement, ignite motivation, and enhance the overall learning experience (Srisawasdi and Panjaburee 2019). By forging connections between learners and real-world scenarios, ARGs employ gamified narratives and comprehensive feedback mechanisms to guide students in refining their inquiry strategies (De Beer and Bothma 2016; Habibi et al. 2022). Research indicates that ARGs foster advanced cognitive skills such as critical thinking, problem-solving, and teamwork through interdisciplinary tasks (Gilliam et al. 2017; Tulloch et al. 2021). In STEM education, ARGs serve as an ideal platform that enables students to hone their critical thinking and collaborative skills within interdisciplinary settings (Stylianidou et al. 2020). These complex, multidisciplinary tasks require students to amalgamate knowledge from various domains to tackle dynamic educational challenges. Such environments not only aid in the transfer and practical application of knowledge, but also potentially enhance students' abilities in deep thinking and innovation. This potential benefit merits further investigation in the context of STEM education.

segments.sourceText: Despite their potential, students encounter numerous challenges during the learning process in ARGs. The inherent uncertainty of puzzles in ARGs, coupled with the complexities of real-world scenarios, heightens the difficulty of problem solving, often impeding students' ability to collect clues and synthesise information for task completion (Gilliam et al. 2017). Throughout the ARG tasks, students may feel frustrated, discouraged, and distracted, which can prevent them from achieving the desired learning outcomes. Some may lose motivation altogether if the challenges surpass their abilities (Richey et al. 2019). Given the complexity and diversity of these tasks, ineffective organisation and internalisation of information can disrupt students' cognitive construction processes (Glazewski and Ertmer 2020). Furthermore, an overload of tasks or information can lead to cognitive overload, undermining the efficiency and effectiveness of their knowledge construction (Sewell et al. 2020; Xu and Ouyang 2022). Successfully navigating these challenges requires learners to possess strong metacognitive skills to monitor their understanding, manage cognitive load, and adjust their problem-solving strategies (Seufert 2018). However, students often struggle to self-regulate effectively in such complex environments (Jin et al. 2023). This highlights a critical need for adaptive, personalised feedback within ARGs to serve as an external scaffold, thereby fostering the metacognitive awareness necessary for successful inquiry-based learning.

segments.sourceText: Virtual agents facilitate learner autonomy by establishing roles akin to tutors or partners, offering essential guidance and feedback throughout the learning journey (Seo et al. 2021). In educational settings, these agents assume a supportive role by fostering independent learning amongst students, without overtly directing the learning trajectory (Wang et al. 2024). Learning is inherently a dynamic process that evolves not only through personal intellectual effort, but also via interactions with others or with technological systems (Pettersson 2021). Virtual agents adeptly mimic the functions of teachers or peers, providing timely feedback and emotional support when challenges arise, thus enhancing the social dimensions of learning. Additionally, they enrich opportunities for collaboration and communication, enabling deeper knowledge construction (Chen et al. 2020; Song et al. 2019). By transitioning traditional face-to-face engagements into novel forms of human-machine collaboration, virtual agents effectively enrich the interactive experience across varied learning settings (Guo et al. 2024).

translation.faithfulZh: 虛擬代理透過建立類似於導師或合作伙伴的角色來促進學習者的自主權，在整個學習過程中提供基本的指導和回饋（Seo et al. 2021）。 在教育環境中，這些代理人透過在學生中培養獨立學習來承擔支援作用，而無需公開指導學習軌跡（Wang et al. 2024）。 學習本質上是一個動態過程，它不僅透過個人智力努力發展，而且透過與他人或技術系統的互動（Petersson 2021）。 虛擬代理人熟練地模仿教師或同齡人的功能，在挑戰出現時提供及時的回饋和情感支援，從而增強了學習的社會維度。 此外，它們豐富了協作和溝通的機會，從而實現了更深入的知識構建（Chen et al. 2020；Song et al. 2019）。 透過將傳統的面對面互動轉變為新的人機協作形式，虛擬代理有效地豐富了不同學習環境中的互動體驗（Guo et al. 2024）。

segments.sourceText: With virtual agents' support, students can effectively complete learning tasks and practises, benefiting from timely feedback that assists them in identifying and rectifying errors (Oker et al. 2020; Sikström et al. 2022). Additionally, virtual agents boost students' self-efficacy and learning motivation through emotional feedback, which also strengthens their social presence in the learning process, reduces anxiety, and ignites their internal drive to learn (Chou et al. 2022; Fountoukidou et al. 2019). This emotional support not only increases students' feelings of security and belonging in virtual environments, but also motivates them to engage more actively in learning activities (Schlimbach et al. 2024). Research indicates that virtual agents not only spur learning motivation but also enhance the efficiency with which students execute tasks, thereby improving their performance and cognitive growth in complex learning scenarios (Krassmann et al. 2019; Lin et al. 2020). Virtual agents are emerging as potent educational tools that provide sustained support, boosting engagement and a sense of achievement amongst students tackling intricate tasks (Sinatra et al. 2021). Whilst the benefits demonstrated in these studies are significant, the effectiveness of most traditional virtual agents is constrained by their underlying technology. Typically reliant on pre-scripted dialogue trees and rule-based systems, their ability to provide truly adaptive, explanatory feedback or understand novel student inquiries is limited (Han et al. 2025). This rigidity can hinder the development of sophisticated learning processes that require more than pre-programmed hints (Al-Abri 2025). Therefore, to enable the kind of dynamic, conversational scaffolding needed for effective learning in varied STEM educational settings, this research turns to the advanced capabilities of LLMs.

translation.faithfulZh: 在虛擬代理的支援下，學生可以有效地完成學習任務和實踐，並得益於及時的回饋，幫助他們識別和糾正錯誤（Oker et al. 2020；Sikström et al. 2022）。 此外，虛擬代理透過情緒回饋提高學生的自我效能感和學習動機，這也增強了他們在學習過程中的社交存在感，減少了焦慮，並激發了他們內在的學習動力（Chou et al. 2022； Fountoukidou et al. 2019）。 這種情感支援不僅增加了學生在虛擬環境中的安全感和歸屬感，還激勵他們更積極地參與學習活動（Schlimbach et al. 2024）。 研究表明，虛擬代理不僅刺激了學習動機，而且提高了學生執行任務的效率，從而提高了他們在複雜學習場景中的表現和認知增長（Krassmann et al. 2019；Lin et al. 2020）。 虛擬代理正在成為強大的教育工具，可以提供持續的支援、提高學生的參與度和完成複雜任務的成就感（Sinatra et al. 2021）。 雖然這些研究中展示的益處是顯著的，但大多數傳統虛擬代理的有效性受到其基礎技術的限制。 通常依賴於預先編寫的對話樹和基於規則的系統，它們提供真正適應性、解釋性回饋或理解新穎學生查詢的能力是有限的（Han et al. 2025）。 這種僵化可能會阻礙複雜的學習過程的發展，這些學習過程需要的不僅僅是預程式設計的提示（Al-Abri 2025）。 因此，為了在不同的 STEM 教育環境中有效學習所需的那種動態的對話式腳手架，本研究轉向了 LLMS 的高階能力。

segments.sourceText: Personalised learning refers to tailoring instructional content, pace, and approach to meet the unique needs and abilities of individual learners (Zhang et al. 2022). Whilst traditional adaptive systems often personalise by recommending pre-defined content pathways (Kasneci et al. 2023), the unique affordance of an LLM is its ability to provide dynamic, conversational, and individualised support in real-time. An LLM is a natural language processing technology trained on extensive datasets to effectively understand and generate human language (Thirunavukarasu et al. 2023), with applications ranging from content summarisation to automated question-answering (Kasneci et al. 2023; Yang et al. 2024). As LLM capabilities advance, they are increasingly used to provide this kind of personalised, data-driven support (Chang et al. 2024).

segments.sourceText: Functioning as virtual agents, LLM-powered chatbots offer robust learning support by moving beyond simple feedback to enhance the learning experience through engagement and personalization (Chen et al. 2024; Lin and Mubarok 2021). By analysing students' real-time progress, LLMs can generate tailored recommendations or prompts to help them overcome challenges (Hu et al. 2024) and can accommodate diverse proficiency levels through dynamic adjustments, thus enabling adaptive learning (Goslen et al. 2024). Whilst prior research has shown these systems can improve general outcomes like learning achievements and motivation (Hew et al. 2023; Lee et al. 2022), their specific capacity to deliver timely, explanatory feedback is particularly well-suited for fostering self-regulated learning skills (Bibauw et al. 2019; Xia et al. 2023). Therefore, this study chooses to focus specifically on how this LLM-driven personalised scaffolding impacts metacognitive awareness and behavioural engagement, two key components of self-regulated learning.

segments.sourceText: Integrating learning support into game environments has been shown to significantly enhance learners' acquisition of knowledge and skills in game-based settings (Liao et al. 2019). However, if the learning support is poorly integrated, it may lead to increased cognitive load, disrupting students' gaming experience (Bainbridge et al. 2022). Virtual agents offer a promising solution by seamlessly embedding learning support into games, enhancing both learning outcomes and the overall gaming experience. This approach achieves the dual objectives of sparking interest and promoting education (Guo et al. 2024). Accordingly, this study incorporated LLM virtual agents into ARG, leveraging the immersive nature of ARG and the interactivity of virtual agents to investigate their potential effects on students' STEM learning performance, particularly in terms of knowledge acquisition, skill development, and engagement.

translation.faithfulZh: 將學習支援整合到遊戲環境中已被證明可以顯著增強學習者在基於遊戲的環境中對知識和技能的獲取（Liao et al. 2019）。 然而，如果學習支援整合不佳，可能會導致認知負荷增加，從而擾亂學生的遊戲體驗（Bainbridge et al. 2022）。 虛擬代理透過將學習支援無縫嵌入到遊戲中，提供有前途的解決方案，增強學習成效和整體遊戲體驗。 這種方法實現了激發興趣和促進教育的雙重目標（Guo et al. 2024）。 因此，本研究將 LLM 虛擬代理整合到 ARG 中，利用 ARG 的沉浸性質和虛擬代理的互動性來研究它們對學生 STEM 學習表現的潛在影響，特別是在知識獲取、技能發展和參與方面。

segments.sourceText: As shown in Figure 1, the LLM-ARG system was designed to facilitate students' engagement with STEM curricula in a simulated real-world environment. Central to the system is ‘V,’ an LLM-Assisted Personal Virtual Agent, which supports students in conducting active inquiries within STEM. The system comprises three core modules: the Game module, the Learning module, and the PVA module (Personal Virtual Agent module). The Game module manages the gaming aspects, including the game plot, quests, non-player characters (NPCs), and exploration scenes. The Learning module oversees the educational components embedded within the game, such as learning rules, materials, tests, and feedback mechanisms. The PVA module integrates the LLM functionality, enabling seamless interaction with both the Game and Learning modules through components such as the LLM platform, chatbot, prompt engineering, and game plugin. This cohesive framework ensures a dynamic and immersive learning experience for students.

segments.sourceText: In designing the functionalities of the LLM virtual agent ‘V’, we adopted a learner-centred approach that provides three primary types of adaptive feedback, which are used consistently throughout this paper: (1) Answer Feedback, which diagnosed conceptual errors and delivered tailored explanations after students submitted responses; (2) Task-Oriented Feedback, which activated milestone reminders and reflective prompts if learners deviated from goals; and (3) Achievement Feedback, which triggered in-game rewards and progress summaries upon subgoal completion. After receiving responses from the model, the system enters the feedback loop. This module consists of Data Display and Visual Support. In Data Display, the system presents feedback return and result display to the game engine, providing users with clear and concise information. In Visual Support, the system provides real-time guidance and interactive support within the game interface, allowing students to receive instant feedback and make prompt adjustments. This feedback loop facilitates continuous interaction and re-engagement, allowing learners to refine their actions and enhance their problem-solving strategies.

segments.sourceText: The cyclic structure of the system ensures that after feedback is processed and presented, students can resume interaction with Agent ‘V’, forming a closed-loop learning cycle. This dynamic process helps maintain engagement whilst allowing continuous improvement through iterative feedback and response adaptation. By seamlessly integrating game-based interaction with model-driven reasoning, the system offers a coherent and efficient educational experience.

segments.sourceText: To evaluate the learning effectiveness of this approach, a quasi-experimental design was adopted, involving 57 students aged 12–13 from two classes at a primary school in eastern China. These students had over 2 years of information technology education and possessed basic computer skills, enabling them to engage in digital game-based learning. One class was designated as the experimental group and the other as the control group. The experimental group, consisting of 28 students (14 boys and 14 girls), utilised the LLM-ARG approach, whilst the control group, comprising 29 students (15 boys and 14 girls), employed the C-ARG approach. All students in both groups were taught by the same teacher to ensure consistency in instruction.

segments.sourceText: The experimental group received real-time feedback through the LLM-ARG system, including knowledge-based feedback, task-oriented feedback, and achievement-driven motivational feedback. Knowledge-based feedback was designed to reinforce learned content, task-oriented feedback supported the construction of cognitive structures, and achievement-based feedback motivated students by rewarding their progress with achievements and items. In contrast, the control group's C-ARG system employed a traditional rule-based e-learning approach. The agent's feedback was limited to pre-scripted responses triggered by predefined rules (e.g., confirming a correct answer or providing a generic hint after an incorrect one). Crucially, this system lacked the LLM's capacity for dynamic, conversational interaction; it could not interpret student-initiated questions in natural language, diagnose the underlying nature of a misconception, or provide personalised metacognitive prompts. This design allows for a direct comparison between a standard game-based learning environment with basic feedback and one enhanced with novel LLM-driven, dialogic scaffolding, which is the focus of our study.

segments.sourceText: In Week 1, learners engaged in introductory activities, which began with a 20-min session to introduce learning activities and rules. Following this, students completed a 30-min pretest to assess academic performance and metacognitive awareness. These introductory activities ensured that all participants had a clear understanding of the learning objectives and initial baseline data before engaging in the main instructional content. During Weeks 2 to 4, both the experimental group and the control group participated in core instructional activities designed to build STEM knowledge and skills through lectures and hands-on problem-solving tasks. Following the instructional activities, each group completed a 60-min ARG task independently. The LLM-ARG group interacted with the personalised virtual agent ‘V’, which provided adaptive, real-time support, whilst the C-ARG group followed the same instructional activities using a system that provided only traditional, non-adaptive guidance, the specifics of which are detailed in the Participants section. Both groups were exposed to identical scenarios, educational content, and task durations to ensure consistency in the learning environment. In Week 5, a 60-min posttest was conducted to evaluate academic performance and post-intervention metacognitive awareness. This design ensured that the ARG intervention was systematically integrated into the standard curriculum, maintaining consistent instructional time and task structure for both groups.

segments.sourceText: At the initial stage of the study, a pretest was conducted to ascertain the prior knowledge of students in both the experimental and control groups before they engaged in the learning activities. In contrast, the posttests were intended to examine differences in the learning achievements of the two groups after employing different learning modalities. Both tests covered knowledge related to kart structure, three electrical systems, and the four key processes, each consisting of 20 multiple-choice questions with a total score of 100 points. All tests were designed by the research team and were meticulously reviewed by experts and teachers with over 10 years of teaching experience to ensure the validity of the assessments. The KR-20 values before and after the tests were 0.72 and 0.74, respectively, indicating acceptable internal consistency of the tests.

segments.sourceText: Metacognitive awareness refers to an individual's ability to reflect on and adjust their own cognitive processes. The metacognitive awareness questionnaire was based on the measurement approach by Schraw and Dennison (1994) and revised by Lai and Hwang (2015). This questionnaire consisted of five items, including questions such as, ‘When I complete a task, I ask myself if what I have learned from the task is sufficient.’ It used a 5-point Likert scale for scoring (1 = strongly disagree; 5 = strongly agree), and with a Cronbach's alpha of 0.83, it demonstrated good reliability.

segments.sourceText: To analyse learning behaviours, student interactions within the ARG environment were captured in detailed system logs. This study adopted the behavioural analysis framework proposed by Liang et al. (2024), resulting in the coding system shown in Table 2. The appropriateness and clarity of this coding scheme were validated through discussions with two experienced teachers prior to the study. Crucially, the data logging and coding process was fully automated by the game system to ensure objectivity and eliminate the need for manual coding. The system logged specific events as follows: ‘E’ (Exploring) was recorded when a student navigated to a new game scene; ‘R’ (Reading learning materials) was recorded when a student opened a knowledge card and kept it on screen for more than 3 s; and ‘S’ (Skipping learning materials) was recorded if the card was closed in less than that time. All other codes (e.g., A, C, I, F, Q) were also logged automatically based on discrete user actions. Because this process was automated, inter-rater reliability analysis was not applicable. This automated process ensured a reliable and detailed record of the gaming experience, which was saved for subsequent analysis.
